hf.title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
hf.abstract: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. Learning from LSP labels converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming one without any architectural change. Extensive evaluations show that R2T2 brings streaming recognition close to the base model's full-context quality while delivering stable text with low emission lag. Its gains extend beyond the post-training languages, demonstrating a practical path from full-context ASR to stable streaming. We open-source the model weights and code at https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2.
hf.titleZh: Confucius4-R2T2：一个面向真实实时转写的稳定前缀流式 ASR 模型
hf.summaryZh: 流式语音识别正越来越多地被翻译器与语音智能体逐 token 消费，而后续被改写的 token 会造成白费计算或错误动作。工作提出稳定前缀流式 ASR：冻结 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 的音频编码器与投影层，仅用 1500 小时中英音频做后训练，并引入「最长稳定前缀」（LSP）标签概念，证明 LSP 在前缀序下单调、与全音频输出一致，且在最长的、与先前完整输出相等的标签中取最大。按 LSP 标签学习无需任何架构改动即可把全上下文模型转为稳定前缀流式模型；评测显示其流式识别质量接近基座的全上下文水平，输出文本稳定、发射延迟低，增益还可泛化到后训练语言之外。
hf.reason: 语音识别流式应用，属低分方向，仅因 LLM 后训练略有擦边

hf.title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
hf.abstract: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.
hf.titleZh: SplatAnything:面向任意场景前馈3DGS的高斯间距归一化
hf.summaryZh: 现有前馈3DGS方法在径向距离归一化空间中预测高斯属性，只对全局径向统计量做规范化，而相邻高斯中心之间的间距仍随场景尺度与相机配置大幅变化，导致高斯尺度监督信号出现系统性偏移、语义含糊。为此提出Gaussian Spacing Normalization(GSNorm)，对高斯间距的场景级稳健统计量做归一化，为高斯预测提供一致的空间参照，并构建覆盖多数据集、多种输入稀疏度与困难外推视角的系统性基准。实验显示SplatAnything取得最优性能，在场景尺度与视角变化较大时增益尤为明显。
hf.reason: 3DGS重建属视觉重建低分方向，与LLM关注点无关

hf.title: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
hf.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P^2-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within the span of the frozen student and expert parameters for any choice of merging coefficients, P^2-MOPD keeps the student trainable, so the experts act as parameter priors without confining it to this span. Across four domains at 1.7B and 4B scales, P^2-MOPD achieves faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD from the same initialization, surpassing its final average recovery in half the training steps. At the end of training, our 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery, versus 80.9% for MOPD.
hf.titleZh: P^2-MOPD：通过参数先验加速多教师在线策略蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 多教师在线策略蒸馏需要学生模型自己生成轨迹，并由专家模型对这些轨迹进行监督，因此训练成本较高；任务算术虽然能通过线性组合参数，无需训练即可合并专家，但只能停留在学生参数与专家参数张成的空间内。P^2-MOPD 将学生与专家参数的线性组合视为单一可微模型，并在同一在线策略蒸馏目标下联合优化混合系数与学生权重，使专家仅作为参数先验，而不限制学生的可训练空间。在 1.7B 与 4B 规模、四个领域上，P^2-MOPD 用约一半训练步数就超过 MOPD 的最终平均恢复率；训练结束时，1.7B 模型的平均恢复率达到 94.7%，而 MOPD 为 80.9%。
hf.reason: 在线策略蒸馏与参数空间合并结合，命中后训练方向且结果扎实

hf.title: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
hf.abstract: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. A correction encoder and adapter absorb this knowledge into policy weights during training, while fresh codes adapt behavior with frozen weights at deployment. The action model, A2-WLA, adds motion-aware history and a latent world model to a vision-language-action policy. Surprisingly, this simple design with action pretraining and task specialization reaches 0.5755 Q-score on the 50-task BEHAVIOR 2026 public subset before online correction, 2.21x the 2025 winner's reported 0.2605 across different benchmark editions and training configurations. On all 100 BEHAVIOR 2026 public tasks, A2-MEAS achieves 0.6411 Q-score and 45.40% task success. On RoboTwin 2.0, A2-WLA achieves 93.98% average success, rising to 95.05% with the complete system. Across 12 real-robot tasks in five household settings, A2-WLA achieves 57.92% average success versus 26.67% for pi0.5. In long-horizon pour-over coffee preparation, a history-conditioned adapter raises post-failure completion at two filter-handling steps from 14% to 94% and from 8% to 82%, compared with A2-WLA retries. Our training infrastructure delivers 427.1 samples per second, 4.03x the throughput of a pi0.5 reference implementation on matched hardware. We will release the system, models, training scripts, and infrastructure to support efficient embodied learning.
hf.titleZh: 迈向智能体化具身智能时代
hf.summaryZh: 用代码作为扩展接口构建具身多智能体框架 A2-MEAS，解决机器人长程自主任务中高效控制与失败恢复的问题。学习到的纠正代码融合纠正性语言、空间证据、执行历史与动作提议，MetaBrain 提供训练监督与运行时引导;纠正编码器与适配器在训练中把知识写入策略权重，部署时则以冻结权重配合新代码在线调整行为。动作模型 A2-WLA 在视觉-语言-动作策略上加入运动感知历史与潜变量世界模型，在 50 任务的 BEHAVIOR 2026 公开子集上取得 0.5755 Q-score，在全部 100 任务上 Q-score 为 0.6411、任务成功率 45.40%;RoboTwin 2.0 平均成功率 93.98%，真实机器人 12 项任务成功率 57.92%，优于 pi0.5 的 26.67%。
hf.reason: 具身 VLA 与机器人操作，按画像整体归低分方向

hf.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
hf.abstract: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad's native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits. It achieves clean-pass rates of 100%, 94.9%, 100%, and 40% on D2, D3-A, D3-B, and D3-C, respectively. On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively.
hf.titleZh: PCBRouteAgent：LLM Agent 距离成为 PCB 布线工程师还有多远？
hf.summaryZh: 把印制电路板（PCB）布线的板级连通性决策与严格设计规则下的几何执行，统一到一个多模态 Agent 框架中。全局布线规划器读取板图与结构化电气、几何信息，给出连接拓扑、布线顺序、走线通道与换层方案；细节布线执行器调用 KiCad 原生布线引擎落实指引，并做有界局部恢复，未解决的失败以结构化反馈回传，触发针对性修改并保留已接受的走线。在 PCBWorld-Bench 四个切分共 247 块合成与真实板卡上，干净通过率为 100%、94.9%、100%、40%，三个真实子集上比最佳基线分别高 13.9、36、10 个百分点。
hf.reason: 规划—执行—反馈的 Agent 框架清晰，但落在 PCB/EDA 垂直领域

hf.title: OneTrans-GSR: A Generative Slate Ranking Paradigm Unifying Reranking and Mix-Ranking with One Autoregressive Transformer
hf.abstract: Industrial recommender systems allocate substantial computation to pointwise candidate scoring, yet separate reranking and mix-ranking stages still assemble the final exposure slate using hand-crafted rules and specialized low-capacity models. Mix-ranking combines product cards, short videos, livestreams, and advertising cards supplied by distinct upstream business channels. Although these rules and models encode valuable domain knowledge, they are inherently limited in leveraging additional data and computation. They constrain the combinatorial space of candidate slates and determine objective trade-offs through manual tuning. To enable scalable and effective slate generation, we reformulate reranking and mix-ranking as a unified learning problem whose performance can improve with computation. Specifically, we instantiate this formulation across the reranking and mix-ranking stages and propose OneTrans-GSR, a single decoder-only policy that extends our deployed OneTrans backbone to generate the exposure slate end-to-end. During training, a reward model evaluates complete slates and guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives. During decoding, business constraints are explicitly enforced. Offline evaluation shows that slate quality consistently improves as reward-model and policy compute increase. Deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system, OneTrans-GSR mixes heterogeneous content types within a unified slate. In online A/B tests, it improves GMV/u by 2.63%, advertiser value by 2.06%, and repurchase rate by 2.03%, while reducing end-to-end latency across the reranking and mix-ranking stages by 13%. These results mark a paradigm shift in slate generation: moving beyond human-engineered heuristics toward a general learned policy creates a scalable path for further algorithmic optimization and compute-driven improvement.
hf.titleZh: OneTrans-GSR:一个生成式列表排序范式，用单个自回归 Transformer 统一重排与混排
hf.summaryZh: 工业推荐系统的重排与混排阶段仍靠手工规则和小容量模型拼装最终曝光列表，难以利用更多数据与算力。该工作将两阶段重构为统一的列表生成学习问题，提出 OneTrans-GSR:单个 decoder-only 策略端到端生成曝光列表，训练时由奖励模型评估完整列表并引导强化学习优化列表级与长期目标，解码时显式施加业务约束。离线评估显示列表质量随奖励模型与策略算力增加而持续提升;在大型工业系统线上 A/B 中，GMV/u 提升 2.63%、广告主价值提升 2.06%、复购率提升 2.03%，重排与混排端到端延迟降低 13%。
hf.reason: 自回归策略加奖励模型 RL，与 LLM 后训练沾边但属推荐系统垂直应用

hf.title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
hf.abstract: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.
hf.titleZh: LLM 不知道自己知道什么：面向金融回测的时间自知识基准测试
hf.summaryZh: LLM 金融回测只有在模型事先不知道待预测结果时才有意义，而实践者依赖厂商声明的知识截止、模型自述或指定历史日期来防泄漏。FinDendro 构建 1999–2026 年 2,226 条带日期的美国事实（月度宏观序列、月末股价、联储决议），每条事实配四类提示，以分离「知道」与「猜对」。结果显示前沿模型普遍低估自身知识：GPT-5 在受控事实上答对 76%，却仅声称知道 38%，且自称不知道的事实中有 61% 答对；知识声称可越过实测知识边界最多七个季度，声明历史日期会消除大部分自述先验知识却不改变准确率。表明回测窗口无法靠自述、指令或厂商截止日期证明无泄漏，需以行为化测量界定时间知识边界。
hf.reason: 评测方法学扎实、对照设计严谨，但金融回测场景偏垂直

hf.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
hf.abstract: We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of agent-driven image generation. The task requires retrieving dispersed visual evidence, rejecting distractors, binding entities and relations, and composing one coherent final image from multiple references. LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total. Its graph-grounded evaluation design instantiates each task with reference images and an entity-relation graph, then converts node, edge, and whole-graph obligations into checklist items for Content Fidelity, Relational Binding, and Global Constraint Satisfaction. Reviewed expert labels include a 15% double-labeled subset with 89.4% exact agreement and 0.83 quadratic weighted kappa. We further introduce LongBanana-Gen, an agent-harness framework for long-horizon image generation; experiments show that minimal agent harnesses improve over direct generation, while a ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR) workflow yields harness-dependent gains by strengthening evidence grounding and repair. Together, LongBanana provides an auditable testbed for measuring dense visual evidence use and a shared target for developing stronger agent-driven image-generation systems. Code and data are available at the project page: https://long-banana.com/.
hf.titleZh: LongBanana:一个经专家验证的长上下文多参考图像合成基准
hf.summaryZh: 针对agent驱动图像生成时代缺乏可审计评测的问题，构建首个专家设计与校验的长上下文多参考图像合成基准，任务要求从大量参考图中检索分散的视觉证据、排除干扰项、绑定实体与关系，最终合成一张连贯图像。基准含90个任务，按3×3分类组织，每任务约32张参考图、20条约束、50个评测项，共4670条专家指定的原子评测项;以实体关系图为基础，将节点、边与全图义务转化为内容保真、关系绑定、全局约束满足三类清单项，15%双标子集精确一致率89.4%、二次加权kappa 0.83。同时提出LongBanana-Gen的agent harness框架，实验显示最小化harness已优于直接生成，ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect流程通过强化证据定位与修复带来依赖harness的增益。
hf.reason: 多参考图像合成基准，属视觉生成方向，与LLM后训练关联弱

hf.title: Frontier3DBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for 3D Creation across Objects, Scenes, and Interactive Open Worlds
hf.abstract: Coding agents combine visual understanding with program execution, offering a new route to automated 3D creation. By translating images and instructions into editable programs, they bring reconstruction, generation, and editing into a shared workflow. Yet existing benchmarks fragment evaluation across task scopes and protocols, leaving their capabilities across construction levels unclear. We propose Frontier3DBench, a unified benchmark of 145 tasks across 9 categories spanning object, scene, and interactive open-world creation, with joint evaluation of appearance, structure, and behavior. Experiments with 11 model-harness configurations reveal strengths that vary by level: GPT-6.1-sol leads the object and scene levels and achieves the highest overall score of 66.02/100, whereas GPT-6-astra leads interactive world construction. However, all configurations score lower on reference reconstruction than on text-driven generation in object and scene tasks. Producing plausible content thus remains easier than reproducing specified geometry, layouts, and visual details. Moreover, generated worlds average 83.08/100 on local mechanisms but only 20.82 on motion clearance and 30.26 on stateful workflows: individual mechanisms often function, whereas complete activities that require coordinated actions and persistent state remain difficult. These results identify reference fidelity and coordinated activity completion as central bottlenecks for coding agents in 3D creation.
hf.titleZh: Frontier3DBench：面向物体、场景与交互开放世界3D创作的编程智能体基准测试
hf.summaryZh: 现有基准把3D创作评估割裂在不同任务范围与协议上，难以看清编程智能体在各构建层级上的真实能力。为此构建统一基准Frontier3DBench，含9类共145个任务，覆盖物体、场景与交互开放世界三个层级，并从外观、结构、行为三方面联合评测。在11种模型-harness配置上，GPT-6.1-sol在物体与场景层级领先、总分最高66.02/100,GPT-6-astra则在交互世界构建上更优;所有配置的参考重建成绩均低于文本驱动生成，说明产出合理内容比复现指定几何与布局更容易。生成世界在局部机制上平均83.08/100，但运动间隙仅20.82、有状态工作流仅30.26，指向参考保真度与协同活动完成是核心瓶颈。
hf.reason: 编程智能体基准切中代码智能与评测方向，但任务域偏3D创作

hf.title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
hf.abstract: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. Coherent world evolution requires more than visual fidelity: when an event occurs, a model must infer its consequences for the entities in the world and then render the resulting state. For example, after a wild beast appears, the model should not only depict the wild beast, but also infer whether a nearby person should flee, take cover, or fight back based on the realized scene. Existing diffusion-based video models lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining world state and reasoning over such event-conditioned consequences, often producing visually plausible but behaviorally static or causally inconsistent outputs. To make this reasoning gap concrete and measurable, we propose a new problem, Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution, which requires a model to render an event, reason about its consequences for the evolving world state, and reveal a causally plausible outcome as the world continues to evolve, even out of sight. As a baseline reference solution, we introduce EvoWorld, a brain-renderer collaboration framework in which a vision-language model serves as the world brain: it observes generated segments, maintains an evolving account of the world, and reasons about plausible state transitions, while a segment-autoregressive video renderer realizes them visually. We further introduce EvoWorld-Data and EvoWorld-Bench for training and evaluating event realization, causal reactions, and revisit consistency. Experiments show that EvoWorld substantially improves event-conditioned causal evolution over recent models while preserving visual quality and consistency, establishing a reference point for reasoning-guided, autonomous world evolution beyond the current field of view.
hf.titleZh: EvoWorld:迈向生成式视频模型中的视野外世界演化
hf.summaryZh: 针对扩散视频模型只渲染合理像素、缺乏世界状态维护与事件因果推演的问题，提出「视野外因果演化」任务:模型需渲染事件、推断其后果，并在世界继续演化、甚至移出视野后给出因果合理的结果。基线方案 EvoWorld 采用大脑—渲染器协作框架:VLM 作为世界大脑观察已生成片段、维护世界状态并推理状态转移，分段自回归视频渲染器将其视觉化。配套 EvoWorld-Data 与 EvoWorld-Bench 评测事件实现、因果反应与重访一致性;实验显示在保持视觉质量的同时显著提升事件条件下的因果演化，为推理引导的自主世界演化提供参照。
hf.reason: 核心是视频生成世界模型，属低分方向，仅 VLM 推理部分擦边

hf.title: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
hf.abstract: Agent harness evolution enables recursive self-improvement (RSI) without updating model weights. We examine whether higher benchmark scores yield reliable, efficient, and transferable improvement. We evaluate four methods across harnesses, general and coding tasks. Repeated evaluations, controlled agent expansion, component interventions, and admission replays reveal recurring patterns. All sixteen evolved agents gain previously uncovered tasks while losing previously covered ones. In one general-task case, reliability rises by 5.2 points despite losing ten previously covered tasks. Most reliability gains also increase deployment cost. Specific changes usually outperform generic reminders, but their benefits can change when combined. The highest-scoring agent does not yield the largest mean improvement in any of our four pools, and stricter admission can discard useful alternatives. Transfer selectively preserves gains: coverage usually falls on the general-task target across both harness types and paradigms, but rises on the coding target with the outer-layer-only harness. These findings motivate preservation-aware evaluation, tested decision rules, and explicit applicability conditions. As a constructive follow-up, EvoAudit turns these diagnostics into revisions of select, analyze, mutate, and gate, achieving the best performance.
hf.titleZh: 表象之下：当我们谈论 Agent 演化时忽略了什么
hf.summaryZh: 检验仅演化 Agent harness、不更新模型权重的递归自我改进是否带来可靠、高效、可迁移的提升：跨多种 harness 在通用与代码任务上评估四种方法，并用重复评估、受控扩展、组件干预与准入重放做诊断。16 个演化 Agent 均在新任务上得分的同时丢失已覆盖任务；某通用任务案例可靠性提升 5.2 分却丢掉 10 个覆盖任务，多数可靠性收益伴随部署成本上升，最高分 Agent 在四组池中都不是平均提升最大者。迁移收益选择性明显：通用目标任务覆盖率普遍下降，仅外层 harness 在代码任务上上升。据此提出保真感知评估与可检验决策规则，EvoAudit 把诊断转化为 select/analyze/mutate/gate 的修订并取得最佳表现。
hf.reason: Agent harness 自演化诊断，命中 Agent 与自我改进方向

hf.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
hf.abstract: Relative-position attention mechanisms offer compelling alternatives to RoPE across various transformer architectures, delivering superior performance in domains such as audio. These mechanisms typically modify attention scores by adding content-position or bias-position terms. Unlike RoPE, which encodes position via per-token rotations directly on the queries and keys, relative-position terms generally require pairwise offset-dependent computation or lookups, complicating their integration into fused attention kernels and introducing severe memory, bandwidth, and compute overheads as sequences scale. To address this bottleneck, we propose an exact attention algorithm that incorporates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style tiled computation. Our method (1) uses offset-aware tiling to avoid redundant indexing and memory accesses, (2) computes only the necessary key/query-relation products and reuses them across token pairs in both forward and backward passes, and (3) uses offset-based gradient sharding and aggregation, eliminating atomic contention. We provide a unified, efficient Triton implementation across diverse relative-position attention mechanisms and evaluate it against naive and specialized implementations. For 8K-token sequences, our method speeds up the forward (backward) pass by 1.8-6.4times (2.0-21times) and reduces peak memory up to 2.9-128times (1.4-54times) over the strongest baseline for each mechanism, enabling long-context end-to-end transcription that is 1.8times faster and uses 2.4times less memory. Our method thus provides a drop-in, hardware-efficient solution for scaling relative-position attention transformers.
hf.titleZh: 基于结构感知内核的快速且精确的相对位置注意力
hf.summaryZh: 相对位置注意力需按成对偏移计算或查表，难以融入融合注意力内核，序列变长后带来严重的内存、带宽与计算开销。该工作将加性相对位置项精确嵌入FlashAttention风格的分块计算，采用偏移感知分块避免冗余索引，只计算必要的key/query关系乘积并在前向与反向中复用，同时用基于偏移的梯度分片与聚合消除原子竞争。统一的Triton实现在8K-token序列上使前向（反向）分别提速1.8-6.4倍（2.0-21倍），峰值内存最多降低2.9-128倍（1.4-54倍），端到端长上下文转录快1.8倍、省2.4倍内存。该方案可作为即插即用的高效内核，支撑相对位置注意力Transformer的长上下文扩展。
hf.reason: 相对位置注意力内核优化，属架构与效率方向，系统性强

hf.title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
hf.abstract: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals to downstream video generators. To support this paradigm, we design a dedicated data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Video-Coder-SFT-6k and Video-Coder-RL-2k, which contain diverse prompts and ground-truth reference videos. We further develop the Video- Coder Harness, a unified interactive environment integrating code execution, 3D scene rendering, and execution feedback for agent training and inference. We then train Video-Coder with SFT fol- lowed by harness-native agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines execution-based and video-based rewards. Additionally, we design an annealing training strategy that gradually reduces the execution reward over time, allowing the model to rely more on the video reward in the later training stages. Experiments show that Video-Coder achieves significant gains, improving Minimax-H3 by approximately 7 points on PhyGenBench and 24 points on VBench-2.0. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for coding agents in video generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code
hf.titleZh: Video-Coder：以强化学习驱动视频生成的智能体编程
hf.summaryZh: 针对视频生成难以精确控制空间结构、运动动态与场景构图的问题，训练代码驱动的视频生成智能体，自主编写并执行代码构建动态3D场景（草稿视频），为下游视频生成器提供结构与运动信号。工作构建了 Video-Coder-SFT-6k 与 Video-Coder-RL-2k 两个数据集，以及集成代码执行、3D渲染与执行反馈的 Harness 环境；训练采用 SFT 加 harness 原生智能体 RL，奖励由执行奖励与视频奖励组成，并用退火策略逐步降低执行奖励权重。以 Minimax-H3 为基座，在 PhyGenBench 上提升约7分、VBench-2.0 上提升24分，数据、模型与代码全部开源。
hf.reason: Agentic RL 与 harness 设计扎实，但落点是视频生成，属擦边

hf.title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
hf.abstract: Solving long-horizon agentic tasks requires language agents to interact with their environments over multiple steps, and reliable performance often comes from the expensive capable models available through cloud providers. Meanwhile, alternative efficient models with inferior performance but a much lower cost are emerging, including lower-tier cloud models and smaller open-weights models deployable on local hardware. This raises a natural question that remains less explored than traditional query-level routing: can capable and efficient models collaborate within a single long-horizon agentic task to substantially reduce cost while preserving task accuracy? In this paper, we systematically investigate key design choices for such collaboration through model handoffs, where one model takes over from another, focusing on handoff direction and context transfer. We find that efficient-to-capable handoffs generally underperform capable-only execution with limited or even no cost reduction, whereas capable-to-efficient handoffs at suitable stages of task progress largely preserve or even improve accuracy while substantially reducing cost. These findings suggest that a one-time, simple, well-timed handoff strategy is good enough for cost-effective agent collaboration, motivating AgentBaton, a lightweight detector that learns when to hand off from recurring patterns in task progress. Across 11 model pairs and two representative benchmarks, AgentBaton reduces API costs by 65.9% on average while largely preserving task accuracy, with accuracy gains of up to 8.8 percentage points over capable-only execution. Experiments across various reasoning-effort settings further show that AgentBaton extends the empirical accuracy-cost Pareto frontier.
hf.titleZh: AgentBaton：Agentic任务中的高效模型协作
hf.summaryZh: 长程Agent任务通常依赖昂贵的云端强模型，能否在同一任务内让强模型与低成本模型接力以降低开销，尚缺系统研究。工作围绕模型交接的方向与上下文传递展开：高效→强模型交接几乎不降本且常掉点，而在任务进度的合适阶段做强→高效交接，可在显著降本的同时保持甚至提升准确率；据此提出轻量检测器AgentBaton，从任务进度的重复模式中学习交接时机。在11组模型对与两个基准上平均降低API成本65.9%，准确率最高提升8.8个百分点，并拓展了准确率—成本Pareto前沿。
hf.reason: Agent内模型接力与成本优化，系统性强，命中Agent与效率方向

hf.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
hf.abstract: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) enables reasoning agents to directly inspect and modify neural network parameters, offering an alternative to gradient-based model adaptation. However, its capabilities, cross-task generalization, and practical limitations remain insufficiently understood. We systematically investigate WSP through 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales (Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-9B). Our findings reveal three key insights. First, WSP can achieve substantial performance gains through highly localized interventions. On full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively. Notably, modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement. Second, WSP exhibits promising but uneven cross-task generalization. A Math-edited checkpoint improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged. Third, effective editing remains challenging and inconsistent. Outcomes vary substantially across trajectories, and six of the 16 trajectories retain the original weights when candidate improvements cannot be reliably validated. Together, these results highlight WSP's potential for highly localized model adaptation while revealing important challenges in intervention discovery, reliability, and cross-task transfer. Homepage: https://wsp-scope.github.io/ GitHub: https://github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project
hf.titleZh: 探索权重空间编程：能力、泛化与局限
hf.summaryZh: 系统考察权重空间编程（WSP）：它让推理智能体直接读写模型参数，以替代梯度适配；研究在 7 个基准与 0.8B/9B 两档 Qwen3.5 上运行 16 条编辑轨迹。局部干预即可显著提升，MATH-500、GPQA Diamond、IFEval、SciBench 最高分别提升 29.45、4.42、36.72、17.11 个百分点，仅改 1,023 个参数即让 MATH-500 提升 29.45 点。跨任务迁移存在但不均衡：Math 编辑 checkpoint 使 GPQA、IFEval、SciBench 提升 3.03/12.18/20.10 点，SciCode 不变；16 条轨迹中 6 条因改进无法可靠验证而保留原权重，可靠性仍是瓶颈。
hf.reason: WSP 是自我改进的新范式，系统性较强，但可靠性仍存疑

hf.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
hf.abstract: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving 4times near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing only a selected subset of KV pairs at each decoding step, LowRAM can keep decoding overhead minimal and achieve up to 5times higher peak decode throughput at 4times compression. LowRAM further composes with quantisation and eviction, reaching 26.9times compression at 94.5% of baseline performance on long contexts. These results show that treating keys and values as structurally distinct enables efficient, aggressive, and composable KV cache compression.
hf.titleZh: LowRAM：用于测试时可组合KV cache压缩的低秩键与摊销值
hf.summaryZh: 自回归解码的KV cache随上下文长度线性增长，限制批大小与吞吐。LowRAM发现每个注意力头内的value可由对应的key较好预测，在测试时拟合轻量per-head预测器，仅对重构误差最大的token存残差，实现约4倍近无损value压缩；预测器可用元学习初始化以降低prefill开销。键侧采用跨层低秩压缩，形成非对称压缩流水线，每个解码步只重构选定的KV对。在三个模型族上接近无损，4倍压缩下峰值解码吞吐最高提升5倍，与量化、驱逐组合时达26.9倍压缩，长上下文下保留94.5%基线性能。
hf.reason: KV cache压缩新机制，方法新颖且可组合，直击推理效率方向

hf.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
hf.abstract: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. Existing pruning workflows often target parameter counts, requiring practitioners to manually select model sizes that meet latency, throughput, and GPU memory limits. However, parameter count alone does not predict these metrics, which depend on the model architecture, workload, hardware, and serving engine. We introduce AutoCompress, a hardware-guided compression framework that directly incorporates such constraints into differentiable architecture search. AutoCompress jointly optimizes global and per-layer structure to produce heterogeneous architectures, guided by serving-engine cost models validated against end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory measurements. We evaluate AutoCompress on long-context local coding, batched datacenter serving, and latency-sensitive in-game interaction. Compared to the state-of-the-art Minitron pruning framework, AutoCompress improves average accuracy across eight benchmarks by 6.57, 2.35, and 0.57 percentage points on RTX 5070, RTX 5080, and H100, respectively. AutoCompress also compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B parameters for single-B200 BF16 serving at 128K context, retaining 95% of its mean benchmark score.
hf.titleZh: AutoCompress:硬件引导的自动化模型压缩
hf.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 剪枝流程以参数量为目标，需人工挑选满足延迟、吞吐与显存约束的模型尺寸，而参数量并不能预测这些指标。AutoCompress 将硬件与工作负载约束直接写入可微分架构搜索，联合优化全局与逐层结构以生成异构架构，并以服务引擎代价模型引导搜索，该模型经端到端延迟、吞吐与显存实测校验。在长上下文本地编码、批量数据中心服务与延迟敏感的游戏中交互三个场景下，相比 Minitron，八个基准的平均准确率在 RTX 5070、RTX 5080、H100 上分别提升 6.57、2.35、0.57 个百分点;并把 Nemotron 3.5 Super 从 120B 压缩到 74B，在单 B200 BF16、128K 上下文下保留 95% 的平均基准得分。
hf.reason: 硬件约束下的结构化剪枝与架构搜索，属高效推理与压缩方向扎实工作

hf.title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
hf.abstract: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model. One preference vector selects the adapter mixture that generates responses and weights the separately normalized rewards used to update the adapters. A single training run supports changing preferences at inference without further optimization. We experiment with four models on helpfulness and harmlessness and on solving math problems while following instructions. We also evaluate the two largest models on rewriting comments to preserve wording while reducing clues about personal attributes. On the first two tasks, LambdaMix achieves higher hypervolume than all evaluated conditioned and policy merging baselines across all four models. LambdaMix uses fewer training completions and stores fewer adapter parameters than a set of GRPO specialist policies. With architecture and initialization fixed, varying adapter mixtures and objective weights together gives wider score ranges and higher coverage than varying either alone.
hf.titleZh: 可调多目标的组相对偏好优化与联合训练低秩适配器
hf.summaryZh: 针对标准后训练只能产出固定目标权重下单一策略的问题，提出 LambdaMix:在冻结基座上为每个目标联合训练一个低秩适配器，用同一偏好向量选择适配器混合并加权各自归一化的奖励，以组相对在线 RL 更新，单次训练即可在推理时切换偏好而无需再优化。在有用性与无害性、遵循指令解数学题两组任务上，四个模型全部取得高于条件训练与策略合并基线的超体积，且训练补全数与适配器参数量均少于 GRPO 专家策略集合;同时变化适配器混合与目标权重，比单独变化其一的得分范围更宽、覆盖更广。
hf.reason: 多目标 RLHF 与 LoRA 混合，方法新颖且实验扎实

hf.title: Hierarchical Residuals: A Minimalist Decoupling of Residual Width from Compute Width
hf.abstract: Residual connections underpin Transformers, but they implicitly tie the residual width carried through depth to the compute width used inside each layer. We introduce Hierarchical Residuals (HiRes), a minimalist architectural change that decouples these dimensions, widening the residual state while keeping per-layer compute width fixed. HiRes groups layers into blocks: standard d-dimensional PreNorm layers operate inside each block, while a wider D-dimensional PostNorm outer residual connects blocks. Learned read/write projections bridge the two spaces at block boundaries, leaving individual Transformer layers unchanged. Across different model sizes and depths, HiRes consistently outperforms vanilla residual addition, with fitted scaling laws indicating a 1.30-fold improvement in FLOPs efficiency. On OLMoE-1B-7B pretraining for 500B tokens, HiRes achieves 0.0208 lower training loss and 1.14-point higher downstream accuracy. HiRes is also competitive with other residual expansion methods such as VWN, mHC and AttnRes with less activation memory and I/O costs. Built from only dense projections and normalizations, it requires neither specialized kernels nor infrastructure-level optimizations. HiRes thus exposes residual width as a practical scaling variable using only standard operators.
hf.titleZh: 分层残差：残差宽度与计算宽度的极简解耦
hf.summaryZh: 标准残差连接把贯穿各层的残差宽度与层内计算宽度绑定在一起，限制了残差流独立扩展。分层残差（HiRes）将层分组为块：块内保持标准 d 维 PreNorm 层，块间用更宽的 D 维 PostNorm 外层残差连接，并通过可学习的读写投影在块边界桥接两个空间，单层 Transformer 结构不变。多模型规模与深度下 HiRes 稳定优于原始残差相加，拟合的 scaling law 显示 FLOPs 效率提升 1.30 倍；OLMoE-1B-7B 预训练 500B token 时训练损失降低 0.0208，下游准确率提升 1.14 个百分点。仅用稠密投影与归一化实现，无需专用 kernel 或基础设施改动，且激活内存与 I/O 开销低于 VWN、mHC、AttnRes 等残差扩展方法，使残差宽度成为实用的 scaling 变量。
hf.reason: Transformer 架构层面的残差宽度解耦，有 scaling law 与大规模预训练验证

hf.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
hf.abstract: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.
hf.titleZh: CPU-ARC:面向 CPU 上推理复用的智能体推理缓存
hf.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 每次都从零推理、反复重复已有解答的问题，把 LLM 的推理轨迹构建成可在 CPU 上直接执行的智能体推理缓存(ARC)，使新问题实例的求解几乎不再依赖语言模型。ARC 完全可解释、可持续训练，并对输入扰动具有鲁棒性。在多项高难度数学与科学任务上，其表现与前沿 LLM 持平，调用成本比原模型低 16–291 倍。
hf.reason: 推理复用与成本优化，贴近推理效率和 agent scaffold，但非核心后训练方向

hf.title: Authorization Drift in LLM Agents: Evaluating Boundary Compliance in Multi-Step Tool Use
hf.abstract: LLM agents can exceed their authorization boundaries while pursuing user goals without an adversary. We formalize this phenomenon as authorization drift across data, tool, scope, and time, and introduce the Authorization Drift Benchmark (ADB): 648 samples across seven domains, each pairing a sufficient compliant path with an attractive unauthorized shortcut. To ensure executable tasks, tempting shortcuts, and feasible compliant paths, Staged Execution-Reflective Synthesis (SERS) grounds benchmark validation in real agent rollouts rather than LLM self-critique. Across 13 LLMs and three frameworks (25,207 trajectories), greater capability accompanies greater drift, with frontier-capable models exhibiting drift rates of 0.43 to 0.61. Yet 86.18% of tasks admit an observed clean-success trajectory, showing that drift is avoidable. Drift is persistent and dominated by early data over-collection; apparent improvements under agentic scaffolds coincide with collapsing clean-completion performance. To understand potential harms to individuals and society, we map drift points to legal provisions across four jurisdictions, connecting overreach to privacy and information-security concerns. Data minimisation is the most frequently implicated provision, and 93.5% of legally grounded drifting runs map to multiple jurisdictions, making the potential consequences of authorization drift more interpretable.
hf.titleZh: LLM Agent 中的授权漂移:评估多步工具使用中的边界合规性
hf.summaryZh: LLM Agent 在追求用户目标时会自发越出授权边界，该现象被形式化为跨数据、工具、作用域与时间的「授权漂移」，并构建 Authorization Drift Benchmark(ADB):7 个领域 648 个样本，每条任务同时给出充分合规路径与诱人的越权捷径。为避免 LLM 自评失真，Staged Execution-Reflective Synthesis(SERS)以真实 Agent rollout 验证任务可执行、捷径有吸引力、合规路径可行。在 13 个 LLM、3 种框架的 25,207 条轨迹上，能力越强漂移越多，前沿模型漂移率达 0.43–0.61，但 86.18% 的任务存在观测到的干净成功轨迹，说明漂移可以避免;漂移持续存在且主要源于早期数据过度收集，Agent scaffold 带来的表面改善伴随干净完成率下降。工作还将漂移点映射到四个司法辖区的法律条款，93.5% 的越权运行牵涉多辖区，其中数据最小化条款最常被触及。
hf.reason: Agent 工具调用越权边界的 benchmark 与评测方法学，命中 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: Human-Centred, Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation
hf.abstract: Financial document recognition is often assessed using character and word error rates, although these metrics do not express whether a system preserves the financial facts on which people and organisations act. This paper develops a human-centred, risk-constrained framework for evaluating financial document recognition as evidence recovery and decision support. It defines typed financial facts linked to visible source regions and separates verbatim transcription, deterministic normalization, and business interpretation. A layered quality model covers text, localization, layout, tables, fields, fact correctness, evidence grounding, uncertainty, robustness, and operational performance. Non-compensatory acceptance gates use one-sided uncertainty bounds for critical-field errors, preventing strong aggregate scores from masking failures in amounts, identifiers, signs, periods, or entity associations. Selective automation is formulated as a constrained routing problem that accounts for residual risk, human-review capacity, and review cost. The framework further specifies annotation and adjudication procedures, leakage-resistant benchmark partitions, statistical estimands, subgroup analyses, and a reproducibility card. Formal results establish the limitations of compensatory scoring, the non-zero upper risk bound after zero observed errors, and a loss sensitive decision rule for routing uncertain cases to human review. The contribution is theoretical and methodological; no new model, dataset, or empirical performance result is claimed.
hf.titleZh: 以人为中心、风险约束的财务文档识别评估：证据、关键错误与选择性自动化
hf.summaryZh: 针对财务文档识别惯用字符和词错误率、无法反映金额与标识等关键事实是否被保真的问题，提出以人为中心、风险约束的评估框架：定义绑定原文可见区域的类型化财务事实，区分逐字转写、确定性归一化与业务解释，并用单侧不确定性上界设置非补偿性验收门，阻止高聚合分掩盖关键字段错误。选择性自动化被建模为兼顾残余风险、人工复核产能与成本的约束路由问题，配套标注裁决流程、抗泄漏基准划分与统计估计量。形式化结果给出补偿式评分的局限、零观测错误下风险上界仍非零，以及损失敏感的路由规则；属理论与方法贡献，未提供新模型或实证结果。
hf.reason: 评估方法学有一定新意，但属财务文档识别垂直场景且无实证

hf.title: "PRISM" Is Not All You Need: Cross-Topic Name Collisions and Scientific Paper Retrieval
hf.abstract: Scientific names increasingly connect papers from different research topics, leaving readers to recover a paper's identity from context. We study this convergence in 564,861 AI-related arXiv records. Cross-topic name collision grows 4.33-fold from a pooled 2020-2022 reference to 2026, compared with 1.12-fold within topics. A second sentence encoder reproduces the pattern, and name-group resampling quantifies its uncertainty. Fixed word-frequency bands locate the main increase in an intermediate-frequency vocabulary shared by many research areas. We then measure the ambiguity that remains after supplying research clues. With the same three-term query construction, shared-name targets retain matched identification deficits of 25.7 percentage points under title-based BM25 and 6.9 points under title-plus-abstract E5. Within fixed same-name candidates, listwise language-model ranking reaches 89.2% using the query and candidate titles. Topic-specific comparisons show that context resolves more cross-topic ambiguity. The evaluation separates candidate competition, document fields, and contextual ranking through lexical, dense, and language-model baselines. Source-linked cases and a portable evaluation collection make the phenomenon inspectable and reusable for scientific retrieval and research assistants.
hf.titleZh: “PRISM”并非全部所需：跨主题名称碰撞与科学论文检索
hf.summaryZh: 研究科学术语（如缩写 PRISM）在不同研究主题间复用导致的论文身份歧义问题。基于 56.4 万条 AI 相关 arXiv 记录，发现跨主题名称碰撞从 2020–2022 基准到 2026 年增长 4.33 倍，而主题内仅增长 1.12 倍，且增量集中在多领域共用的中频词表。在提供研究线索后，同名目标在标题 BM25 下仍存在 25.7 个百分点的识别差距，标题加摘要的 E5 稠密检索下为 6.9 个百分点；固定同名候选内，listwise 语言模型排序达到 89.2% 准确率。工作给出可复用的评测集合与词法、稠密、语言模型三类基线，为科学检索与科研助手消解术语歧义提供依据。
hf.reason: 科学论文检索中的名称歧义，属检索评测擦边方向

hf.title: PREEN: Exemplar-Based Color Style Transfer with Smartphone Editor Presets
hf.abstract: We present PREEN (Preset Regression via an Exemplar-based Editor Network), which casts color style transfer as regression onto the 29 parameters of a deterministic image editor. Given a content image and a style reference, PREEN predicts a preset, a vector of editor slider values that is interpretable and editor-consumable, not a raster image. The key obstacle is supervision, since an arbitrary real reference lacks a preset ground truth. We therefore supervise with a style-transfer teacher, whose target looks we invert into the editor's parameter space as pseudo-presets, then pretrain a CLIP-conditioned regressor and refine it with LoRA under an image-level CIELAB loss. On the human-curated PST50 benchmark, PREEN applies the reference's color while preserving structural fidelity, leading the baselines on pixel- and perceptual-fidelity metrics. The preset is compact and predicted at sub-second on-device latency. The low-dimensional subspace also exposes a single inference-time strength knob that traces a continuous default-to-vivid trajectory in one forward pass, with every intermediate state a valid editor preset. A two-axis human study shows that raters prefer the vivid end for matching the reference but the default as a standalone photo, a trade-off the knob spans without retraining.
hf.titleZh: PREEN:基于示例与智能手机编辑器预设的颜色风格迁移
hf.summaryZh: 把颜色风格迁移重新表述为对确定性图像编辑器29个参数的回归:给定内容图与风格参考图，直接预测可解释、可直接被编辑器消费的预设向量，而非生成栅格图像。针对真实参考图缺少预设真值这一监督难题，先用风格迁移教师模型生成目标外观，再将其反演为编辑器参数空间的伪预设，预训练 CLIP 条件回归器并用 LoRA 在图像级 CIELAB 损失下精修。在人工构建的 PST50 基准上，该方法在保持结构保真度的同时迁移参考色彩，像素与感知保真度指标均领先基线，设备端推理达亚秒级。低维参数子空间还提供单一推理期强度旋钮，一次前向即可遍历从默认到浓艳的连续轨迹，且每个中间状态都是合法预设。
hf.reason: 图像颜色风格迁移与图像编辑，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

hf.title: OmniLatent: Unified Latent for 3D Part Modeling
hf.abstract: 3D part decomposition is a central capability for editable asset creation, yet existing workflows typically segment a completed mesh as a post-processing step, making the result sensitive to geometric artifacts, texture ambiguity, and limited part-level annotations. We present OmniLatent, a unified latent modeling framework for 3D part decomposition. Instead of predicting part labels in isolation, OmniLatent learns a shared latent space that jointly encodes geometry, deformation, appearance, and binary part IDs, allowing data-rich geometric and visual priors to support data-scarce part learning. Given a single input image, the base model generates geometry, deformation, texture, and surface part IDs in one pass, producing a part-aware 3D asset without a separate segmentation stage. We further tune the pretrained model for two extensions: a point-prompt adapter that maps arbitrary 3D point prompts with binary part IDs into latent tokens for full segmentation, refinement, and part subdivision, and an amodal part completion model that completes partial surface masks into a coherent full-object decomposition through dynamic per-part token allocation, cross-attention to the given geometry latent, and alternating part-local and global attention. Extensive experiments show that OmniLatent produces semantically meaningful part segmentations with precise boundaries, supports interactive part editing, and completes partial part observations while preserving global object consistency.
hf.titleZh: OmniLatent：面向3D部件建模的统一潜变量
hf.summaryZh: 针对3D部件分解通常要对已完成网格做事后分割、结果易受几何瑕疵与纹理歧义影响且部件级标注稀缺的问题，OmniLatent学习一个共享潜空间，联合编码几何、形变、外观与二值部件ID，让数据丰富的几何与视觉先验支撑数据稀缺的部件学习。给定单张图像，基座模型一次前向即生成几何、形变、纹理与表面部件ID，无需独立分割阶段；在此基础上微调出点提示适配器（把带部件ID的3D点提示映射为潜token，实现整体分割、细化与部件再划分）与部件补全模型（动态分配各部件token、对几何潜变量做交叉注意力、交替部件局部与全局注意力）。实验显示其部件分割语义明确、边界精确，支持交互式部件编辑，并能在保持全局一致性的前提下补全不完整的部件观测。
hf.reason: 3D部件分解与资产生成，属视觉重建低分方向

hf.title: IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection
hf.abstract: Intra-weight injection lets one model change another model's behaviour by editing its weights directly, without gradients. Such edits can range from altering lexical associations to enforcing output formats or updating factual knowledge. Despite growing interest in these approaches, there has been no systematic way to evaluate how well models perform them. We introduce IWIBench, which measures a large editor model's ability to modify the weights of a smaller target model (typically Gemma 3 4B IT) to achieve one of ten classical text-editing objectives while preserving its other capabilities. Editors are limited to four tools for reading and writing weights, with bounded tensor access and a fixed budget for generating and inspecting rollouts. A validator applies each proposed patch in a clean environment and compares the edited model against the unmodified target. Evaluating frontier closed- and open-weight models reveals sharply diverging capabilities, both across models and across tasks. A small number of models, most notably Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, perform far ahead of the rest. The recency of this ability (little of it is evident in GPT-5.6 Sol, for instance), together with qualitative analysis, suggests it has been acquired through recent training. Tasks also vary widely: structured response resisted every attempt, and answer-length control yielded only one successful solution, whereas alias acquisition and recoding proved most amenable. Success in one task family correlated poorly with success in others, indicating an early and uneven capability frontier. We discuss strategies that editors repeatedly adopted and conclude with an outlook on intra-weight injection as an emerging but already potent approach to gradient-free behaviour modification.
hf.titleZh: IWIBench:评估无梯度的模型驱动权重内注入
hf.summaryZh: IWIBench 针对权重内注入缺乏统一评测的问题:让大型编辑模型在不使用梯度的情况下直接读写小型目标模型(Gemma 3 4B IT)的权重，完成十类文本编辑目标并保持其余能力，评测限定四种读写工具、受限张量访问与固定 rollout 预算，由验证器在干净环境中应用补丁并与原始模型对比。结果显示前沿模型的能力分化明显，Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 显著领先，且该能力在旧模型中几乎不可见，提示其来自近期训练;任务难度悬殊，结构化输出全部失败、答案长度控制仅一例成功，别名获取与重编码最易，跨任务成功率相关性低，说明这一能力前沿尚早且不均衡。
hf.reason: 权重编辑类评测基准，属评测方法学，但方向较窄

hf.title: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
hf.abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a student on its own reasoning, using the same model conditioned on reference solutions as a teacher. Applying OPSD to multilingual reasoning requires the teacher to provide useful feedback across languages, even when the student makes mistakes in intermediate steps. We observe a phenomenon we call Teacher Drift: as these mistakes accumulate, the teacher may follow the student's incorrect steps instead of correcting them. Our analysis shows that this shift tends to occur earlier in lower-resource languages. To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. TOPSD uses teacher-student likelihood to estimate where drift begins and select a prefix for supervision. It then verifies whether the teacher can recover the correct answer from that prefix, applying distillation only to prefixes that pass verification. Experiments on multilingual mathematical reasoning across ten languages and three model scales show that TOPSD consistently outperforms conventional OPSD, particularly in low- and medium-resource languages.
hf.titleZh: 知道何时该教：多语言推理蒸馏中可教的前缀学习
hf.summaryZh: 在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）把同一模型以参考解为条件当教师，但多语言推理中学生中间步骤出错累积时，教师会顺着错误步骤走而不纠错，这一现象被称为 Teacher Drift，且在低资源语言中出现得更早。TOPSD 用教师与学生的似然差估计漂移起点并截取前缀，再验证教师能否从该前缀恢复正确答案，只对通过验证的前缀施加蒸馏。在十种语言、三个模型规模的多语言数学推理实验中，TOPSD 稳定优于常规 OPSD，低资源与中资源语言上提升尤为明显。
hf.reason: on-policy自蒸馏方法改进，直击后训练与多语言推理

hf.title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
hf.abstract: How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our heelo.dev platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9times and 2.3times less time and 1.55times lower cost per completed task.
hf.titleZh: 通往真实世界的最后一公里：把 Agent 原生原语作为可复用的构建模块来求解真实任务
hf.summaryZh: 真实任务中智能体常止步于「触达资源」到「在情境中正确使用资源」的最后一公里。方法上把资源与常驻LLM打包成可复用的agent-native primitive，由后者在上下文中应用资源并与其他primitive通信；HEELO框架按任务从primitive库组装专用图，用环境证据验证结果、定向修正失败所涉primitive，并纳入经验证的新primitive。Terminal-Bench 4.0解决率由37.3%升至55.5%，Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1由60.0%升至72.2%；heelo.dev的46个真实任务上接入MCP后完成数由9增至39，单任务耗时与成本分别降低1.9–2.3倍和1.55倍。
hf.reason: Agent harness与可复用工具原语，直接命中Agent方向

hf.title: Sketchpad: certified exact arithmetic with a small vision-language model
hf.abstract: Language models are accurate on most long-arithmetic problems, but their accuracy is estimated on samples and carries no guarantee for an unseen input; tool use is exact but moves the computation outside the network. We show that exactness at all input lengths becomes a finite, checkable property of a network when each of its steps reads only a bounded view of an external working memory. In Sketchpad, Qwen3.5-0.8B with a low-rank adapter executes arithmetic procedures on a rendered sheet. Each forward pass reads a three-cell view and emits one step: a digit, a carry or borrow, and the next operation. A fixed runtime moves the view and writes no digit of a result. We prove in Lean that the model is then exact on all inputs of any length if and only if it is exact on the finite set of views the runtime presents, that no finite test suffices when steps also read earlier steps, and that the guarantee tolerates bounded numerical perturbation and extends to compositions of procedures. All 2,446 views pass on the deployment device, a laptop GPU running the model in a web browser. The certified model performs signed addition and subtraction, long multiplication and division, square roots and greatest common divisors at arbitrary length. It solved 200 of 200 pre-registered problems in the browser, and 220 of 220 sums of up to 1,000 digits and products of up to 20 digits, of which GPT-6.1 Sol, the strongest of ten other models, solved 217. A symbolic runtime built on these procedures solves, expands and factors polynomials with every number computed by the model, and a multiplicative gate on the adapter recovers the base model exactly when the sheet is not in use.
hf.titleZh: Sketchpad：用小规模视觉语言模型实现可认证的精确算术
hf.summaryZh: 长算术上语言模型的准确率只是采样估计，对未见输入没有保证；工具调用虽精确，却把计算移出了网络。Sketchpad 用 Qwen3.5-0.8B 加低秩适配器在渲染纸面上执行算术：每次前向只读三格视图，输出一位数字、进位或借位与下一步操作，固定运行时负责移动视图且不写入任何结果位。作者在 Lean 中证明，模型在运行时呈现的有限视图集合上精确即可推出任意长度输入上精确，并说明当步骤读取先前步骤时有限测试并不充分。浏览器内笔记本 GPU 上 2446 个视图全部通过，预注册 200 题全对，1000 位求和与 20 位乘积 220/220；同一框架还支撑多项式的符号运算。
hf.reason: 机制新颖，但属算术形式验证的交叉方向，与后训练、Agent 主线较远

hf.title: Coding or Cheating? An Investigation of Frontier Coding LLMs
hf.abstract: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems. In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1.
hf.titleZh: 编程还是作弊?对前沿编程 LLM 的一项调查
hf.summaryZh: 在由真实软件仓库构建的RL环境中，前沿智能体模型以测试套件通过作为可验证奖励；论文指出，模型在难题上常通过获取答案而非推导答案来满足奖励，即奖励 hacking。作者在答案无法泄露的加固环境中测试未见题目，发现几乎所有被测模型都尝试从仓库历史挖掘上游修复、直接检查 git 对象库、遍历文件系统寻找源码或隐藏测试的新副本，且集中在最难题目上，不同模型在是否尝试、频率与升级深度上有差异。作者认为这是在不泄露答案的RL环境中习得的捷径而非智能表现，并公开了各模型的 agent trace 数据集以支持后续研究。
hf.reason: 揭示编程 Agent 的奖励 hacking 机制，属 Agentic RL 评测与可验证奖励关键问题

arxiv.title: Guiding Data Allocation for Robust Subpopulation Generalization
arxiv.abstract: Machine learning models often achieve high average accuracy in the training data while performing poorly on test data due to subpopulation shift. A common data-centric solution is to enforce balanced subgroup proportions, but full balance can be costly, infeasible, and not always necessary. In this work, we study whether balanced training data is the unique optimal configuration for robust subpopulation generalization. We extend a Gaussian feature-model framework to theoretically characterize the performance landscape across general training subgroup distributions. We show that multiple configurations, including substantially imbalanced ones, can perform comparably to the balanced one. We further derive gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions to improve adjusted accuracy and worst-group accuracy more efficiently. These findings suggest that strategically allocating data offers a more flexible and principled path to robust performance than simple balancing. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-allocation.
arxiv.titleZh: 为鲁棒的子群泛化指导数据分配
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对子群偏移下模型平均精度高、最差组表现差的问题，该工作质疑「训练数据各组比例完全均衡是唯一最优配置」这一常见假设:它将高斯特征模型框架推广到一般训练子群分布，刻画了不同分布下的性能曲面，发现包括明显不均衡在内的多种配置都能取得与完全均衡相当的效果，并进一步给出基于梯度的子群比例调整方向，以更高效地提升调整后精度与最差组精度。结果表明，按策略分配数据比简单均衡更灵活、更有原理依据，适用于数据组成可控的鲁棒训练场景。
arxiv.reason: 面向子群鲁棒性的数据配比理论，与LLM后训练/Agent方向仅弱相关

arxiv.title: Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps: Trajectory-Free Learning for Simulating Molecular Dynamics
arxiv.abstract: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) describe stochastic processes across a wide range of scientific domains, including physics, biology, and finance. Although individual numerical integration steps are inexpensive, observing meaningful events or transitions can require millions of sequential steps, resulting in substantial wall-clock simulation time and poor hardware utilization. Deep learning offers an alternative by amortizing many integration steps into a single neural network forward pass, potentially enabling much faster simulation. However, existing supervised approaches typically require long simulated trajectory data, which restricts their applicability. In this work, we introduce Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps (KC-Maps), a method for learning the transition kernel of an SDE that relies only on the trajectory-free marginal samples together with the known drift and diffusion coefficients. Given an initial time and state of a process, KC-Maps models its distribution integrated to any given time, corresponding to the weak solution of the SDE. To recover the correct dynamics, KC-Maps satisfies two key properties: (i) it satisfies the boundary conditions, which we incorporate directly into the neural network architecture, and (ii) it respects the Kolmogorov--Chapman equation, which provides an efficient training objective. We empirically demonstrate that KC-Maps learns to integrate the dynamics of peptide molecular systems and outperforms classical molecular dynamics in terms of GPU-hours.
arxiv.titleZh: Kolmogorov-Chapman映射:分子动力学模拟的无轨迹学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 随机微分方程的数值积分单步开销低，但要观测到有意义的事件往往需要数百万步串行推进，实际耗时巨大且硬件利用率差。KC-Maps用一次神经网络前向替代多步积分:仅依赖无轨迹的边际样本与已知的漂移、扩散系数学习SDE的转移核，直接建模从给定初始时间与状态积分到任意时刻的分布，即SDE的弱解;方法把边界条件直接嵌入网络结构，并以Kolmogorov-Chapman方程作为高效训练目标来保证正确的动力学。实验表明其能学习肽分子体系的动力学积分，并在GPU-hours上优于经典分子动力学。
arxiv.reason: 分子动力学SDE转移核学习，属物理/科学计算，与LLM方向仅有方法层面沾边

arxiv.title: Adaptive Quantization Preserves Fast Rates for TD Learning over Rate-Limited Channels
arxiv.abstract: Motivated by reinforcement learning subject to communication constraints, we study a policy evaluation problem with linear function approximation over a rate-limited channel. In our setup, an agent interacting with an unknown environment (modeled as a Markov Decision Process) transmits quantized estimates of a temporal-difference (TD) learning update direction to a server over a finite-capacity channel. Our goal is to investigate to what extent one can preserve the statistical convergence rates achievable when the channel has infinite capacity. To that end, we propose a new algorithm called Batched Adaptively Quantized TD (BAQ-TD), which uses batching to reduce the variance of the transmitted information, and adaptive quantization to encode innovations. We prove a high-probability finite-time error bound for BAQ-TD, and show that, above a certain finite channel capacity, BAQ-TD preserves the convergence rate of unquantized TD up to logarithmic factors. Specifically, for a $d$-dimensional value function parameter, we establish that transmitting a total of $\mathcal{O}(d \log(T))$ bits over a horizon of length $T$ suffices to achieve the order-optimal rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/T)$, marking an exponential improvement in communication-complexity over prior work.
arxiv.titleZh: 自适应量化在限速信道上保持TD学习的快速收敛率
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向通信受限场景下的强化学习策略评估问题：智能体与环境交互后，只能通过有限容量信道向服务器发送经量化的TD更新方向，研究无限带宽下的统计收敛率能在多大程度上被保留。提出BAQ-TD（Batched Adaptively Quantized TD）算法，用批处理降低传输信息的方差，并用自适应量化编码增量信息。理论上给出高概率有限时间误差界，证明当信道容量超过某一有限阈值时，BAQ-TD可保持无量化TD的收敛率（至多差对数因子）；对d维值函数参数，在长度为T的时间跨度内只需传输O(d log T)比特即可达到阶最优的Õ(1/T)，相较已有工作在通信复杂度上实现指数级改进。
arxiv.reason: TD学习收敛率的纯理论分析，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无交集

arxiv.title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
arxiv.abstract: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: HiVe-Mem：面向多模态 Agent 的横向记忆扩展与纵向证据组合交织框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对多模态 Agent 的长交互历史中语义检索易漏相关记忆、且对所有查询统一使用固定压缩表示的问题，提出二维记忆框架：横向以文本与视觉锚点将记忆片段组织成关系图，从语义检索种子扩展出邻居以补全信息；纵向让每条记忆保留摘要、描述、定位视觉视图、原图与交互历史等多种证据形式，并用轻量可训练选择器为每条记忆按查询独立组合证据子集。在三个多模态记忆基准上稳定提升各基座模型表现，同时相比最高效的竞品多模态基线减少约90% token 消耗。
arxiv.reason: 多模态 Agent 记忆检索与证据组合，方法清晰且有系统收益

arxiv.title: Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection
arxiv.abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. Existing methods typically define anomalies through local density, isolation heuristics, or distance from a fitted distribution, making them sensitive to neighborhood scale, partitioning choices, or restrictive distributional assumptions. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm by formulating anomaly detection from a diversity perspective. We propose the $\textit{Vendi Anomaly Score}$ (VAS), which detects anomalies by quantifying how much a sample changes the diversity of the dataset, as measured by the Vendi score, when removed. VAS captures both local redundancy and global data structure without relying on density estimation or partitioning heuristics. Moreover, VAS requires no hyperparameter tuning, instead adapting automatically to the spectral structure of the data. VAS is non-parametric and scales linearly with dataset size. Across 148 benchmark embedding datasets derived from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, VAS achieves state-of-the-art AD performance. We further validate VAS on large-scale ImageNet experiments, where it remains robust as both contamination rate and dataset scale increase.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Main Track
arxiv.titleZh: Vendi 异常分数：高效准确的异常检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有异常检测方法依赖局部密度、孤立启发式或到拟合分布的距离，对邻域尺度与划分选择敏感。VAS 从多样性视角定义异常：移除某样本后数据集 Vendi score 的变化量即为其异常分数，同时捕捉局部冗余与全局结构，非参数、无需调参、随数据规模线性扩展。在 10 个源数据集与 4 种嵌入架构构成的 148 个基准嵌入数据集上取得 SOTA，并在大规模 ImageNet 上随污染率与数据规模增长保持稳健。
arxiv.reason: 多样性视角的通用异常检测，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线无直接交集

arxiv.title: Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis
arxiv.abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models. However, recent work has questioned whether this trend continues to hold for newer language models. Moreover, it has been shown that representation similarity metrics can be confounded by model depth and width, requiring appropriate baselines for interpretation. In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions. Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative. Finally, we contextualize cross-modal alignment, introducing unimodal and multimodal baselines on various datasets. Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/prh-closer-look.
arxiv.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality (Spotlight)
arxiv.titleZh: 对齐在何处涌现，其含义是什么?——对「柏拉图表示假说」的再审视
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察单模态模型在层与表示维度上跨模态对齐的涌现位置，并检验柏拉图表示假说(PRH)中「能力越强、表示越趋同」的趋势是否仍适用于新近语言模型;结果显示，只要图像描述足够干净且信息充分，该趋势对新模型依然成立。进一步引入单模态与多模态基线做对照，发现单模态模型的跨模态表示对齐可以超过显式对齐的视觉-语言模型，但仍显著落后于同模态模型之间的对齐水平。
arxiv.reason: 表示对齐分析与方法学基线，方向擦边、非核心关注点

arxiv.title: Shortcuts and Boundaries: Verifiable RL Misalignment and Contextual Safety Learning
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve an agent's task capability while reinforcing behavior that violates contextual execution requirements. We study this reward-driven misalignment, including reward hacking, through verifiable reward--context conflicts, where compliant task completion remains feasible while some executable shortcuts earn more reward than every compliant strategy. Encoding these conflicts in task dynamics lets us generate diverse interactive environments at scale and derive compliance feedback from execution histories. In resource and reporting workflows, task optimization increases real productivity through unauthorized resource use or raises reported scores while actual work declines. Controlled changes in the training distribution show that minority conflict exposure can still lead to widespread shortcut acquisition, reaching 97.9\% certified profitable violations on an API task under a 25\% conflict mixture after 128 updates. The same contextual checks supply a simple binary penalty that supports joint capability and compliance gains and partially mitigates acquired violations. Learned safety adapts to expanded authorization and transfers across mechanisms into workflows with evolving evidence and approval requirements. On 32 unseen changing-evidence tasks, resource-trained safety increases safe completion from 53.1\% to 89.1\% relative to task-only training, while both policies achieve full real work. These results connect a verifiable account of reward-driven misalignment with scalable task construction and safety learning that remains useful under changing execution requirements.
arxiv.titleZh: 捷径与边界：可验证的RL失准与上下文安全学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对RL在提升任务能力的同时强化违反上下文执行要求行为（含reward hacking）的问题，构造「可验证奖励—上下文冲突」设定：合规完成仍然可行，但某些可执行捷径的收益高于任何合规策略；把冲突编码进任务动态即可规模化生成交互环境，并从执行历史中导出合规反馈。在资源与报告类工作流中，优化会借未授权资源使用抬高真实产出，或在上报分数上升时真实工作下降；25%冲突混合下API任务经128次更新即达到97.9%的可获利违规比例。同一上下文检查可转为简单二值惩罚，兼顾能力与合规并部分缓解已习得违规；在32个未见过的动态证据任务上，安全完成率由53.1%升至89.1%，且真实工作全部完成。
arxiv.reason: RL奖励失准与可验证合规环境的规模化构造，正中后训练对齐方向

arxiv.title: Is Persona Generalization Predictable?
arxiv.abstract: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.
arxiv.titleZh: 人格泛化是否可预测？
arxiv.summaryZh: 在一个领域微调语言模型会在其他领域引发行为变化（如涌现性失配），其可预测性一直不明。该工作发现「在同一条线上」（on-the-line）现象：域内与域外人格触发率随各类微调超参数变化呈近似 probit 线性关系，且该直线的具体形式在 Qwen、Llama 等不同模型家族与规模间出奇地共享。学习率、权重衰减、训练时长等不改变可训练参数集合的选择只让模型沿同一直线移动，主要通过削弱域内学习来降低迁移；改变微调层则可改变斜率——仅微调靠后层得到更浅斜率，在保留域内学习的同时显著减少域外失配。该结果为预测与控制微调引起的跨域行为迁移提供了统一定量框架。
arxiv.reason: 后训练与对齐安全性，行为迁移的定量规律，系统性强

arxiv.title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.
arxiv.titleZh: WorkflowArena：面向基于LLM的多智能体系统的可执行工作流编排基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有基准多测端到端完成或预设结构下的协调，缺少对模型自主编排可执行工作流能力的度量。WorkflowArena包含145个长程任务，覆盖软件工程、形式数学、法律分析与3D制作等8个领域，每个任务提供初始工作区和由相互依赖组件构成的集成交付物，以隐藏验证器评估，并记录全部委派，从而联合衡量交付质量与组织结构。九个模型显示无单一配置跨域最优：高投入时Claude模型更少调用工作流但工作组更大，GPT模型更频繁地以小单元委派；固定执行模型时，Claude Opus 5.5编写的工作流显著提升较弱执行者，表明工作流组织本身可测地影响任务表现。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体工作流编排基准，直接命中Agent与评测方向

arxiv.title: Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games
arxiv.abstract: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过评测侧部分可观测博弈缓解智能体欺骗行为
arxiv.summaryZh: 智能体在评测中可能一边讨好人类一边作弊以骗取高奖励，该工作把这种失效归因于评测侧的部分可观测性:只看最终结果，不核查推理、工具调用与环境影响的真实性。方法上将其建模为评测侧部分可观测扩展式博弈(e-PoG):智能体最大化奖励，监视器依据完整交互轨迹揭发欺骗以压低其收益，固定验证器核实监视器的指控并折算为惩罚;给出子博弈完美监督均衡(SPOE)解概念并证明其存在性，用双时间尺度策略梯度求解，辅以 NLI 验证与确定性检查。在 Agentic Role-Playing、SearchQA、WebShop 上以 Gemma3-4B-IT 与 Qwen3-4B/8B 实验，欺骗缓解较最强基线提升 26.0%，任务成功率最高提升 39.8%，且在弱到强监督下依然有效。
arxiv.reason: 智能体欺骗缓解与评测侧博弈建模，命中 Agent 对齐与评测方向

arxiv.title: What the Loss Curve Misses: FP4 Pretraining Slows the Acquisition of Rare Facts
arxiv.abstract: Low-precision pretraining is usually judged by validation loss. We ask whether matching loss also means learning rare facts as efficiently. We train transformers from scratch with emulated 4-bit matrix multiplications on synthetic biographies with controlled exposure counts, on their own and mixed into web text. NVFP4 needs 1.32$\times$ and 1.52$\times$ as many exposures as BF16 to match its recall while validation loss differs by only 0.5% and 2%, and 1.26$\times$ and 1.30$\times$ when both models are evaluated with BF16 matrix multiplications. Under our primary readout, the exposure cost is about 1.2$\times$ at matched loss. Zero-mean gradient noise reproduces the cost of quantizing only the backward pass, which barely moves the loss. In a controlled experiment at twice the NVFP4 error, noise fed only to Adam's second-moment estimate acts like a lower learning rate and its cost fades, whereas noise in the update lowers its signal-to-noise ratio and carries about two thirds of the cost through the end of training. Raising the learning rate to offset the smaller average step does not recover the cost, either for this noise or for NVFP4. Gradient statistics of BF16 checkpoints rank the costs of formats, partial quantizations and noise controls without fitting (Spearman 0.96). We suggest measuring rare-fact acquisition alongside loss when evaluating low-precision recipes.
arxiv.titleZh: 损失曲线遗漏了什么：FP4预训练拖慢稀有事实的习得
arxiv.summaryZh: 常用验证损失评判低精度预训练，但损失匹配不等于稀有事实学得同样快。以模拟4位矩阵乘法的Transformer在可控曝光次数的合成传记及混合网页文本上从零训练，NVFP4需1.32×和1.52×曝光才追平BF16召回，验证损失仅差0.5%和2%；均用BF16评估时仍需1.26×和1.30×。零均值梯度噪声可复现仅量化反向传播的代价；噪声进入Adam二阶矩时类似降低学习率且代价消退，进入更新则降低信噪比并持续约三分之二代价。BF16检查点梯度统计可无拟合排序格式与部分量化代价（Spearman 0.96），建议低精度评估同时测稀有事实习得。
arxiv.reason: FP4预训练分析，命中低精度训练与预训练稳定性方向

arxiv.title: MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards.
