We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: MaxIM：通过强化学习实现最大信息量的增量摘要
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对无界交互历史的有界记忆维护问题，将增量摘要建模为容量受限的信息论奖励塑形问题：基于价值次优性界，证明约束序列信息损失等价于最大化未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然，并引入递归一致性条件，以摘要与已观测历史的互信息最大化保证摘要扎根于历史。为缓解稀疏延迟奖励带来的信用分配难题，使用参数化非对称critic计算逐步变分互信息下界，形成稠密奖励。在长程科学阅读与多轮对话基准上，MaxIM在严格token预算与更长horizon下于事实扎根、autorater综合指标和下游任务效用上优于RL、SFT与prompt类基线，且无需昂贵的人类偏好标注。
arxiv.reason: 记忆摘要+RL奖励塑形，直击Agent记忆与后训练方向

arxiv.title: How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors
arxiv.abstract: One hundred known errors were planted into 10 open-access psychology papers, and the modified papers were then run through frontier models and two commercial AI review tools. The best single system caught 71 of the 100 errors, while the worst caught 30. Pooling every system's output caught 93. Models are only partly correlated in the errors they find, which makes ensembling a big lever for finding issues in papers. Seven errors could not be caught by any system, and all seven were omissions: information deleted from a paper rather than mistakes inserted into it. Refine.ink contributes more unique catches than any other single system, though it is expensive on a per-error basis. False positives were not measured, and how this error distribution compares to the distribution of errors in real papers remains unknown. The papers, errors, model outputs, and full experiment log are public, so that others can build on this toward a comprehensive evaluation benchmark across disciplines.
arxiv.comment: 5 pages; accepted at Cognitive Security for Human-AI Systems (CogSec 2026), a non-archival workshop at ACM HCOMP / CI 2026
arxiv.titleZh: AI同行评审效果如何？基于100个植入错误构建的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 把100个已知错误植入10篇开放获取心理学论文，再交给前沿模型与两款商用AI审稿工具检测：最佳单系统检出71个错误，最差仅30个；汇总所有系统输出可达93个，说明各模型发现的问题只部分重叠，集成是提升检出的主要杠杆。有7个错误无任何系统检出，且全部属于从论文中删去信息这类遗漏，而非插入错误。Refine.ink的独有检出最多，但按单错误计成本偏高。假阳性未测量，该错误分布与真实论文的差异也未知；论文、错误、模型输出与完整实验日志均已公开，便于扩展为跨学科的评测基准。
arxiv.reason: AI审稿评测基准，属评测方法学，但规模小、仅限心理学

arxiv.title: Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks
arxiv.abstract: The push towards circularity and Re-X principles presents a challenge to SMEs, particularly due to increasing product complexity that impedes the adoption of disassembly automation. This paper introduces and compares two frameworks for extracting disassembly instructions from unstructured information sources, such as disassembly manuals. Our goal is to transform natural language text into a structured, curated and machine-readable format. We implemented and tested a rule-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework against a generative AI framework leveraging LLMs. The performance of both approaches was compared using real-world disassembly manuals. This work provides the necessary data foundation for developing and automating future disassembly processes.

arxiv.titleZh: 拆卸指令的自动化知识获取流水线：NLP与生成式AI框架的比较

arxiv.title: Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference
arxiv.abstract: Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and ADNI, we benchmark our approach using two measures: namely, effectiveness and identity preservation. While effectiveness is a measure of how faithfully the counterfactual attribute is rendered, identity preservation measures whether the same unit (image) is being rendered, both of which are crucial for high-dimensional counterfactual inference. We present the tradeoffs of using inversion-based and inversion-free approaches in our work.
arxiv.titleZh: 免反演的高维反事实推断

arxiv.title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.

arxiv.titleZh: Agentic-OPD:通过在线策略蒸馏为 Agentic 任务恢复被遗忘的 Agent 能力

arxiv.title: Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging for Detection of Chicken Breast Fillet Myopathies in Chicken Fillets
arxiv.abstract: Woody Breast (WB) myopathy is a major quality defect in broiler chickens characterized by fibrosis, increased tissue hardness, and altered structural properties that affect product quality. Conventional palpation is subjective and labor-intensive, while many non-destructive methods require specialized equipment or substantial computational resources. This study developed a smartphone-based transillumination and 3D point-cloud framework for non-destructive WB severity classification. A total of 267 chicken breast fillets, including normal breast (NB, n = 87), mild WB (MWB, n = 85), and severe WB (SWB, n = 95), were evaluated using RAW transillumination images and 3D point clouds acquired with an iPhone 16 Pro. A total of 91 features, comprising 14 image-derived, 76 geometric, and one physics-informed Beer-Lambert attenuation feature, were extracted. Partial correlation controlling for thickness revealed a significant association between image characteristics and WB severity (r = 0.413, p < 0.0001), indicating optical information independent of fillet geometry. SWB tissue exhibited approximately 26% greater light attenuation per unit thickness than NB. The 2D-only models achieved approximately 82% test accuracy, while the multimodal ensemble combining Fusion-DGCNN, XGBoost, and physics-guided logistic regression (PGLR) achieved approximately 90% accuracy. These findings demonstrate the complementary value of optical, geometric, and physics-informed features and establish the feasibility of smartphone-based, non-destructive WB severity assessment.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向鸡胸肉肌病检测的智能手机深度感知透射成像

arxiv.title: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
arxiv.abstract: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.
arxiv.titleZh: 大语言模型作为开放世界自动化机器学习的通用搜索器

arxiv.title: Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
arxiv.abstract: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git
arxiv.titleZh: 锚定行为而非参数：用单个共享提示实现免排练持续学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对单提示持续学习中共享提示更新时易破坏旧类功能的问题，提出TEA-Prompt，放弃在参数空间冻结或扩展组件，转而锚定提示的行为。方法包含两部分：token评估模块为每个提示token给出由输入决定的连续相关性分数并注入注意力logits，实现软性任务专精而不丢弃token；注意力行为锚定损失仅用类别的紧凑高斯查询统计（不存储旧图像），按token过去的相关性加权，将各token的注意力输出约束在类相关查询区域附近。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R与CUB-200上以仅0.38M参数取得最优准确率并显著降低遗忘。

arxiv.title: LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion
arxiv.abstract: Log-based anomaly detection is increasingly dominated by large pretrained models, from BERT-scale encoders to 8B-parameter language models, which require GPUs at inference time and are difficult to deploy on the monitoring nodes where logs are produced. We present LogCDM, a compact detector that scores each log session using three complementary signals: the next-event surprise of a small causal Transformer, the distance between a graph-attention embedding of the session's own transition graph and that of a normal reference graph, and a transition-drift statistic that we show is exactly a frequency-weighted chi-squared divergence between transition kernels. The divergence view yields an asymptotic null distribution, a length-standardized score, and a per-edge decomposition that explains each alarm. A sigmoid gate fuses the three signals; under a shared-covariance Gaussian model, this gate is the Bayes posterior, and its learned weights indicate which signal each dataset relies on. With 8.1-8.8M parameters and no GPU required at inference, LogCDM reaches F1 scores of 0.984 on HDFS, 0.870 on chronologically split BGL, and 0.850 on Thunderbird, within 0.013-0.12 of an 8.1B-parameter LLM detector evaluated under the same protocol and above all compact baselines on BGL. It scores a session in 5.5-10.5 ms on a CPU. Ablations show that the structural signals add 0.025-0.030 F1 on BGL and Thunderbird but almost nothing on HDFS, consistent with the learned fusion weights.

arxiv.title: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
arxiv.abstract: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT
arxiv.titleZh: PORT：通过鲁棒 Token 级重加权实现偏好优化

arxiv.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.

arxiv.title: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people seek and consume information, including accounts that differ across languages and regions, especially on contested topics. Supporting diverse information seeking requires models to help users navigate competing narratives across languages and information streams. We define six capabilities necessary for diverse multilingual information seeking: three foundational capabilities for narrative inclusion, narrative exclusion, and missing narrative identification; and three higher-level capabilities for presenting diverse narratives, preserving narrative coverage under confirmatory queries, and maintaining information parity across languages. To guide the development of those information seeking capabilities, we introduce \textsc{NarrativeBench}, a benchmark comprising 1,333 news articles in 23 publication languages across 23 contested topics and 460 Reddit-grounded queries. Evaluating 14 LLMs across 24 query languages, we find that current models lack the capabilities needed to reliably navigate diverse narratives, limiting users' control over the perspectives they receive and leaving substantial gaps in exposure to competing accounts even when diversity is explicitly requested. Information access also differs across query framings and languages, risking echo chambers, linguistic filter bubbles, and information disparities that weaken the common ground needed for democratic discourse. \textsc{NarrativeBench} provides a foundation for developing information systems that give users across languages and regions agency to navigate diverse narratives.
arxiv.titleZh: 叙事鸿沟：LLM 能否帮助我们穿行于跨语言的不同叙事之间？
arxiv.summaryZh: 聚焦LLM作为信息中介时，能否帮用户跨越语言与信息流获取相互竞争的叙事。工作定义六项能力（叙事纳入、叙事排除、缺失叙事识别，以及呈现多元叙事、确认性查询下保持叙事覆盖、跨语言信息对等），并构建NarrativeBench：涵盖23种出版语言、23个争议话题的1,333篇新闻与460条Reddit来源查询。评测14个LLM、24种查询语言后发现，模型普遍缺乏可靠导航多元叙事的能力，即使用户显式要求多样性仍存在明显暴露缺口，且信息获取随查询表述与语言而变化，带来回声室与语言过滤气泡风险。该基准为多语言信息系统的公平性与用户自主性研究提供评测基础。

arxiv.title: Clique Constraints for Exact Causal Structure Learning
arxiv.abstract: Exact score-based causal structure learning supports explicit structural constraints and optimisation certificates, but its branch-and-cut search can be computationally demanding. We augment exact causal structure learning methods with an upper bound on the maximum clique size of the learned undirected skeleton, enforced at integer candidates through lazy cycle and clique constraints. On static linear-Gaussian Erdős-Rényi and scale-free DAGs, we evaluate callback order, alternative clique-cut policies, incumbent repair, fractional separation, and Big-M bounds. We report causal-recovery metrics jointly with optimality gaps, primal and dual bounds, node throughput, MIPSOL events, and callback cost. Two variants receive particular attention: B3 selects the most violated minimal (k+1)-clique inequality at each callback, whereas C3 repairs an infeasible integer candidate by deleting violating edges and refitting affected regression columns using QR-based least squares. The results do not indicate that clique constraints uniformly accelerate optimisation. However, their benefit depends on graph density, sample size, and cut-management policy, while large collections of correlated constraints can reduce node throughput. Tighter valid Big-M bounds reduced the fixed-budget optimality gap in most tested settings, without necessarily changing SHD or F1 at a fixed time limit. These findings characterize the computational trade-offs of clique-constrained exact causal learning, and identify selective separation and incumbent repair as promising directions.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于精确因果结构学习的团约束
arxiv.summaryZh: 精确的基于评分的因果结构学习支持显式结构约束与最优性证书，但其分支切割搜索的计算开销很高。该方法为学习到的无向骨架的最大团大小增加上界，并在整数候选解处通过惰性环约束与团约束施加该上界，同时系统评估回调顺序、不同团割策略、现有解修复、分数分离与 Big-M 界。在静态线性高斯 Erdős–Rényi 与无标度 DAG 上，团约束并未普遍加速优化，其收益取决于图密度、样本量与割管理策略，大量相关约束还会降低节点吞吐；更紧的有效 Big-M 界在多数设定下缩小了固定预算下的最优性间隙。这些结果刻画了团约束精确因果学习的计算权衡，并指出选择性分离与现有解修复是有前景的方向。
arxiv.reason: 精确因果发现与整数规划，与 LLM 关注方向基本无关

arxiv.title: Inference Validation for Regulated AI: Building a Decision Pipeline on NVIDIA AIPerf
arxiv.abstract: Deploying large language models in regulated industries requires more than picking the fastest inference engine: it requires evidence that a configuration meets contractual and legal obligations before it serves a single customer request. We describe Runway, an internal validation harness built at MasterControl that builds a governed decision pipeline around NVIDIA AIPerf. The key insight is separating concerns: AIPerf provides the trusted measurement, while Runway provides the experiment design that comes before it and the compliance, cost, and audit decisions that come after. We describe the architecture and the storage model that makes caching and audit one mechanism. We report three findings from Runway sweeps: TensorRT-LLM and vLLM rankings invert with concurrency; a newer, pricier GPU instance can be the cheaper one per request; and speculative decoding behaves differently across engines under load, so engine configuration can outweigh engine choice.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向受监管AI的推理验证：在NVIDIA AIPerf上构建决策流水线
arxiv.summaryZh: 在受监管行业部署LLM需要可审计的证据，而不只是挑最快的推理引擎；MasterControl内部工具Runway围绕NVIDIA AIPerf构建受治理的决策流水线，把可信测量、实验设计与合规、成本、审计决策分层解耦，并以同一套存储模型把缓存与审计统一为同一机制。三组扫描结果显示：TensorRT-LLM与vLLM的排名会随并发度反转；更新更贵的GPU实例按单请求成本计反而更便宜；投机解码在不同引擎与负载下表现不一致，引擎配置的影响可超过引擎选型本身。适用于推理服务选型与合规评估场景参考。
arxiv.reason: 推理引擎选型与合规评测，涉及投机解码，属效率方向工程案例

arxiv.title: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
arxiv.abstract: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: $Σ$-LeWM：通过S-信息学习世界模型以用于机器人控制
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向机器人操作与运动的世界模型通常依赖解码器重建，以防止表征坍缩并获得可预测的隐空间;近期工作如JEPA、LeWorldModel转向无解码器方案，仅用隐空间前向动力学预测器加熵正则稳定训练。该工作在其基础上再引入两个隐空间损失:逆向动力学预测器与逆动作预测器，对隐表征施加更强结构约束。在标准世界模型基准和两个仿真机器人操作任务上，该方法在控制性能与规划效率上均有提升，目标是让基于模型的控制更适用于真实机器人的实时场景。
arxiv.reason: 机器人世界模型与控制，属具身智能低分方向

arxiv.title: KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers
arxiv.abstract: Post-LayerNorm Transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. While prior research has focused on stabilising Post-LayerNorm by improving conditioning at initialisation, stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates, forcing additional compromises. In the decoder-only settings we study, existing Post-LayerNorm methods fail to outperform strong Pre-LayerNorm baselines. We propose KiteNorm, a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. This approach is motivated by a bound on the LayerNorm Jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing, alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. KiteNorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training, supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. Across decoder-only Transformers up to 1.3B parameters, KiteNorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates, with scaling laws favouring KiteNorm across depth, width, batch size, and training budget. Ablations show that each component is necessary for the full stability and performance gains.
arxiv.titleZh: KiteNorm：让 Post-LN Transformer 稳定且可扩展的方差正则化
arxiv.summaryZh: Post-LayerNorm 难以扩展到深层，大学习率下稳定性明显退化，且在 decoder-only 设定下始终打不过强 Pre-LN 基线。KiteNorm 从约束隐状态方差入手：用残差缩放与方差正则化控制训练全程的方差增长，并配合标量化的双重归一化为 skip 分支和残差分支提供各自可学习的尺度；理论动机是 LayerNorm Jacobian 的上界表明方差增大会加剧梯度消失，同时有经验证据将其与秩坍缩联系起来。在最大 1.3B 参数的 decoder-only Transformer 上，KiteNorm 在各自最优学习率下优于现有最强基线，scaling law 在深度、宽度、batch size 与训练预算四个维度上都更有利，消融实验显示各组件对稳定性与性能增益均不可缺少。
arxiv.reason: Post-LN 训练稳定性新方法，含理论动机与 scaling law，命中架构与预训练方向

arxiv.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.
arxiv.titleZh: 多轮临床智能体的安全强化学习：稠密奖励何时胜过结果奖励
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对可验证结果奖励的 RL 在多轮序贯决策中效果不明的问题，构建药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查、剂量滴定三个受控临床环境，包含隐藏状态、查询成本、自适应 oracle 与确定性结果校验器。仅用结果奖励的 GRPO 常提高总奖励却导致过早承诺、单问题坍缩与罕见高危病例失败；对降低不确定性的提问给予稠密信用，可提升留出价值与中危病例支持，并避免高危种子崩溃。分离探索与利用能进一步提升高危支持，但会造成低危病例过度收集信息。过程信用强度依任务而变，RL 也难以修复有偏监督数据留下的稀有行为缺口。
arxiv.reason: 多轮 agent 的 RLVR 奖励设计，方法学扎实但临床域受限

arxiv.title: Scaling Taxonomy-Free Image Labeling with Generative AI: A Multimodal
arxiv.abstract: Providing real-time multimodal insights into images is challenging because it requires low latency, high description accuracy, and scalable solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient. For example, given a new image of an outfit, we would like to generate insights that the image depicts "earth tones" and "linen pants" and allow users to explore similar ideas along these themes. Traditional strategies to generate such insights would typically involve building taxonomies producing a golden set labeled by humans, training models on these datasets, and deploying these models for online inference services. Such workflows are constrained by fixed taxonomy, high labeling cost, limited labeling coverage in sample space, and human errors and expertise gaps in labelers. In addition, these methods are expensive and cumbersome to iterate over time. Recent trends have started exploring generative AI models for online insights, but this method suffers from long latency and prohibitive costs to support a high volume of requests or large amounts of offline labeling needs. We present Generative Labeling On Clusters (GLOC) as a solution to provide highly scalable, cost-effective, low latency, and high accuracy online image insight services. GLOC leverages highly optimized image embeddings to form image clusters that are semantically close to each other for the purpose of the type of insights, and summarizes the insights at the cluster level, which effectively generalizes to members in the cluster. At Pinterest, GLOC powers image descriptors and pivot query suggestions for Hybrid Search, which is a multimodal search service enabling users to search with both an image and a text query. Our offline and online A/B tests demonstrate that GLOC significantly outperforms previous methods, delivering improvements in quality and efficiency.
arxiv.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4th CJ Workshop at KDD 2025 (https://sites.google.com/view/kddcjworkshop2025/accepted-papers), also related: https://arxiv-org.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/2/MOD-93955
arxiv.titleZh: 用生成式 AI 扩展无分类体系的图像标注：一种多模态方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 传统图像洞察依赖人工构建分类体系、标注黄金集再训练模型，受限于固定类别、标注成本高与覆盖不足；直接用生成式模型在线生成则延迟高、成本难以支撑大规模请求。GLOC 先用高度优化的图像嵌入做语义聚类，再在簇级别调用生成式模型总结洞察，从而泛化到簇内所有成员，兼顾低延迟与低成本。该方法已在 Pinterest 支撑图像描述词与 Hybrid Search 的 pivot 查询建议，离线与线上 A/B 测试显示质量与效率均显著优于此前方案。
arxiv.reason: 生成式模型做图像标注的工业系统，属多模态应用而非模型研究

arxiv.title: A local language model layered with rule-based and neural detectors for clinical text de-identification: an open-source toolkit and evaluation
arxiv.abstract: Objectives: To measure whether a locally hosted large language model (LLM), stacked with deterministic and clinical named-entity recognition (NER) detectors, finds more protected health information (PHI) than open tools, and at what precision. Materials and Methods: DeidSharp, an open-source .NET toolkit, combines the findings of pluggable detectors (patterns, a clinical NER model, a local 26B mixture-of-experts LLM) and fails closed on any detector error. Configurations fixed on tuning halves were compared, under a prespecified protocol, with deid, Philter, the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, OpenAI Privacy Filter and GLiNER on reporting halves of PhysioNet's nursing notes (889 spans) and semi-synthetic MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries (29,023 spans), and on synthetic ASQ-PHI queries, with paired patient-level bootstrap intervals. Results: In the nursing notes, against Stanford/Penn, the recall-first stack found 98.9% of PHI (+2.8, 95% CI 1.4 to 4.4) at 9.3 points lower precision; the precision-first stack, without NER, found 96.5%, matching Stanford/Penn, at 19.6 points higher precision (83.2%). In the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points (recall-first 95.3%, +21.5, 20.5 to 22.4), almost entirely on generated untyped names; on typed labels all three exceeded 99%. All four prespecified comparisons held. No configuration beat deid significantly on its home corpus; Philter found more discharge-summary spans than the recall-first stack at 23 points lower precision. Discussion: The LLM was the main detector and NER added place names; asked to verify its own findings, the LLM discarded a quarter of true PHI. Conclusion: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors offers recall-first and precision-first operating points without sending text off-site.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; supplementary material as ancillary file. Code: https://github.com/valburkin/DeidSharp
arxiv.titleZh: 结合规则与神经检测器的本地大模型临床文本去标识化：开源工具包与评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对临床文本 PHI 去标识化中开源工具召回不足、调用云端 API 又存在隐私外泄风险的问题，DeidSharp 以 .NET 开源工具包的形式，把可插拔检测器（正则模式、临床 NER 模型、本地 26B MoE 大模型）的命中结果分层融合，任一检测器出错即 fail-closed。在 PhysioNet 护理记录（889 个 span）与半合成 MIMIC-IV 出院小结（29,023 个 span）上，召回优先配置的召回率达 98.9%（较 Stanford/Penn 高 2.8 点），在出院小结上为 95.3%（+21.5 点），增益几乎全部来自生成的无类型人名；精确优先配置（不含 NER）在护理记录上以 19.6 点更高的精确率（83.2%）取得与 Stanford/Penn 持平的召回。结果表明本地 LLM 叠加确定性规则可在数据不出院的前提下提供召回优先与精确优先两种工作点，适用于院内合规部署。
arxiv.reason: 临床去标识化垂直应用，LLM 系统与评测做得扎实但偏离主线

arxiv.title: Multi-Agent Screening: What Agreement and Acceptance Cannot Tell You
arxiv.abstract: When AI agents screen items for a costly human assessor, as in agentic search, e-discovery and AI reviewing of papers, only what they pass gets judged. We show what each kind of evidence can establish about their errors, even with unlimited data. Agreement shows that agents concur, not that they are right, however many there are. Acceptance by the assessor gives precision but only a lower bound on recall. Knowing which agents found which relevant items gives an upper bound on recall if agents' finds are not negatively correlated, and caps what one more agent can add if agents are interchangeable. Without assumptions about the agents, recall can be pinned down only by judging items they did not pass: a random sample of these estimates how many relevant items were missed, to any chosen accuracy, and the sample needed does not grow with the number of agents.
arxiv.titleZh: 多智能体筛选：一致性与接受度无法告诉你的事
arxiv.summaryZh: 在智能体搜索、电子取证与AI审稿等场景中，AI智能体先筛选条目，人类评估者只判定被放行的部分。该工作系统分析了各类证据即使在数据无限时能对智能体的错误得出什么结论：一致性只说明智能体彼此意见相同，不说明其正确；评估者的接受情况给出精确率，却只是召回率的下界；若各智能体的命中不呈负相关，知道哪些智能体找到了哪些相关条目可给出召回率上界，并在智能体可互换时限制再加一个智能体带来的增益。在不加任何假设时，召回率只能通过判定未被放行的条目来确定，随机抽样可按任意指定精度估计漏掉了多少相关条目，且所需样本量不随智能体数量增长。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体筛选的评测理论，偏统计方法学，与Agent评测擦边

arxiv.title: Fisher-Glass Learning: Classification Bounds and Subpopulation Audits
arxiv.abstract: Accurate classifiers can fail when background cues change without altering the correct labels. Predictive performance alone does not quantify how much task information remains after accounting for such nuisance variation. Here we extend the Fisher-glass framework to connect nuisance-adjusted information with local classification difficulty and subpopulation auditing. We derive lower bounds on local minimax excess classification risk under explicit distinguishability and decision-separation conditions, alongside statistical audits accounting for estimation error and regularization. On Waterbirds, a feature-based diagnostic of task-background alignment selects an accurately classified group, with selection frozen before held-out evaluation. Across five training seeds, background replacements preserving the extracted bird foreground and labels yield 93.2% accuracy when background type is preserved and 40.6% when it changes, a controlled difference of 52.6 percentage points. Separately, search using task labels and a fixed nuisance direction identifies an independently evaluated population with 98.8% membership-weighted accuracy and low estimated projected predictive Fisher information. Training and acquisition experiments show that information gains and predictive gains can diverge. These findings support joint assessment of predictive performance, information under declared nuisance models and controlled sensitivity when diagnosing vulnerability and evaluating model improvements.
arxiv.titleZh: Fisher-Glass 学习：分类误差界与子群体审计
arxiv.summaryZh: 分类器在背景线索变化而正确标签不变时可能失效，仅凭预测准确率无法量化扣除这类冗余变化后还剩余多少任务信息。工作扩展 Fisher-glass 框架，把经过冗余调整的信息量与局部分类难度、子群体审计关联起来：在显式可区分性与决策分离条件下推导局部 minimax 超额分类风险下界，并给出计入估计误差与正则化的统计审计流程。在 Waterbirds 上，基于特征的诊断先选定一个分类准确率高的群体，并冻结该选择，之后再进行留出评估；跨五个训练随机种子，保留前景并替换背景时，准确率从背景类型保持时的 93.2% 变为背景改变时的 40.6%，受控差异达 52.6 个百分点。用任务标签和固定冗余方向搜索，还能定位到一个独立评估群体：其成员加权准确率为 98.8%，但估计的投影预测 Fisher 信息很低；训练与数据获取实验进一步表明，信息增益与预测增益可能彼此分离。
arxiv.reason: 分类鲁棒性与子群体审计方法，与 LLM 关注方向无直接交集

arxiv.title: Generalized Adaptive Boosting and the Geometry of Mistakes
arxiv.abstract: Not all mistakes are alike. For example, in medical diagnosis, false positive and false negative mistakes have a different impact and should not be aggregated. By revisiting the classical theory of boosting through this lens, we introduce the notion of $Z$-learner, which returns weak hypotheses achieving joint false-positive/false-negative guarantees $(\mathrm{FP},\mathrm{FN})$ from some set $Z \subseteq [0,1]^2$. This formulation generalizes the standard notion of $γ$-weak learning--recovered by taking $Z=\{(z_1,z_2): z_1+z_2<1/2-γ\}$--and allows for more flexible notions of weak learnability that account for the impact of the distribution on the achievable learning guarantees. This raises a natural question: which sets $Z$ are boostable? We answer this by giving a complete geometric characterization that unifies, as special cases, both the classical boosting dichotomy and the recent multi-objective extension of Bressan et al. (COLT 2025). We also present an adaptive algorithm for boosting $Z$-learners without relying on the prior knowledge of $Z$, generalizing AdaBoost's ability to handle unknown margin parameters. Finally, we demonstrate that $Z$-learners can achieve confidence amplification. However, the analysis is significantly more involved than in classical boosting and relies on the centerpoint theorem from discrete and computational geometry.
arxiv.titleZh: 广义自适应提升与错误的几何
arxiv.summaryZh: 经典boosting理论把所有错误一视同仁，但医疗诊断等场景中假阳性与假阴性的影响不同，不应被合并。论文提出Z-learner，要求弱假设同时达到假阳性与假阴性的联合保证，推广了γ-弱学习的概念，并追问哪些集合Z可以被提升。作者借助离散与计算几何中的中心点定理，给出可提升集合Z的完整几何刻画，统一了经典boosting二分法与Bressan等（COLT 2025）的多目标推广；还提出无需已知Z的自适应算法，推广了AdaBoost处理未知margin参数的能力，并证明Z-learner可实现置信度放大。
arxiv.reason: 经典boosting学习理论，与LLM关注方向基本无关

arxiv.title: TACTUS: A Robotic Palpation System for Spatially Heterogeneous Hardness Mapping of Woody Breast Myopathy
arxiv.abstract: Woody breast (WB) myopathy is a spatially heterogeneous fibro-degenerative condition of the broiler Pectoralis major muscle. Existing mechanical reference methods rely on single-point or sequential compression measurements, limiting characterization of spatial hardness variability. This study presents TACTUS (Tactile Adaptive Conformal 3D Uniform Sensing), an automated tactile array that generates thickness-normalized, three-dimensional hardness maps at 20 anatomically distributed locations within approximately 30 s. TACTUS integrates 20 independently motorized tactuators with force-sensing resistors and encoder-driven linear actuators, alongside a LiDAR depth camera for surface profiling and adaptive compression. The system was evaluated using 100 broiler breast fillets across four WB severity classes (Normal, Mild, Moderate, Severe). TACTUS identified significant force differences among severity classes (ANOVA, p < 0.001), with the strongest differentiation in the cranial region and a significant caudal effect not detected by texture-analyzer measurements. Fillet-level TACTUS force showed moderate but significant correlation with texture-analyzer measurements (Pearson r = 0.441, p < 0.001). Semivariogram, local change entropy, and heterogeneity analyses revealed increasing and anatomically structured hardness variability with WB severity. These findings demonstrate TACTUS as an automated, operator-independent platform for spatially resolved mechanical characterization and ground-truth generation to support hyperspectral and near-infrared spectroscopy-based WB classification systems.
arxiv.titleZh: TACTUS:用于木质化胸肌病变空间异质硬度建图的机器人触诊系统
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对木质化胸肌(WB)病变硬度呈空间异质分布、现有单点或顺序压缩测量无法刻画的问题，构建了TACTUS自动化触觉阵列:20个独立电机驱动触压单元配合力敏电阻与编码器线性执行器，并以LiDAR深度相机做表面轮廓测量与自适应压缩，约30 s内在20个解剖位点生成厚度归一化的三维硬度图。在100块肉样、四个WB严重度分级上评估，各严重度间力值差异显著(ANOVA,p<0.001)，颅侧区分度最强，并检出纹理分析仪未发现的尾侧效应;个体级力值与纹理分析仪测量中度相关(Pearson r=0.441,p<0.001)。半变异函数与局部变化熵分析显示硬度变异性随严重度升高且呈解剖学结构，系统可作为空间分辨机械表征与高光谱/近红外分类真值生成的免人工平台。
arxiv.reason: 机器人触诊硬件与禽肉品质检测，属农业/生物医学垂直应用，与LLM无关

arxiv.title: Agnostic Marginal-Nonuniform Learning
arxiv.abstract: We study the problem of binary classification in the marginal-nonuniform learning framework in the agnostic setting. In this model, the constants in the learning rate may depend on the marginal distribution of the unlabeled data, but the guarantee must hold uniformly over all conditional distributions of the labels. We also study fine-grained rates. We consider two criteria. (1) The standard agnostic setting, where the learner competes with the best concept in the class. In this setting, an immediate consequence of standard agnostic PAC learning results gives us the optimal rate of $\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$ for every class $\mathcal{H}$ with finite $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})$ and shows that arbitrarily slow rates are necessary otherwise. This also gives us the optimal fine-grained rate of $\sqrt{\tfrac{\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})}{n}}$. Therefore, the dependence on the marginal distribution does not help, which is in contrast to the realizable setting. (2) In the relaxed agnostic setting, where the learner competes with $(1+λ)$ times the error of the best concept for a fixed $λ\in (0,1]$, the picture from the realizable setting reappears. We obtain a trichotomy of the achievable optimal rates: exponential rates of the form $e^{-n}$ arise precisely when the class is finite; linear rates of the form $\tfrac{1}{n}$ arise when the class is infinite but $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})$ is finite; and arbitrarily slow rates occur when $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})=\infty$. We also obtain the optimal fine-grained rate of $\tfrac{\mathrm{uVCE}(\mathcal{H})}{λn}$, where $\mathrm{uVCE}(\mathcal{H})$ is a recently introduced combinatorial complexity dimension called the uncentered $\mathrm{VC}$-eluder dimension.
arxiv.titleZh: 不可知边际非均匀学习

arxiv.title: A Lattice-Based HMM Approach to Aruz Scansion of Ottoman Poetry
arxiv.abstract: Ottoman Divan poetry is composed in aruz, a quantitative meter based on the weights of syllables. The meter is sensitive to specific characters recorded in the original writing in the Arabic script. This work is concerned with automatic meter finding and scansion alignment for Ottoman Divan poetry, especially on modern Turkish spelling without the special diacritics that scholarly transliterations of Ottoman preserve. We define two tasks on this input, first identifying the meter used in the poem, and second aligning the meter's weights with the syllabification of the poem, identifying the flaws and freedoms the poet has taken along the way. We build a corpus of 52,000 lines split by poet, with scansion annotations for 500 test lines, and a robustness benchmark generated at the deviation rates measured on real web and OCR copies. Our model is a hidden Markov model over the positions of each meter, decoded over a lattice of every candidate path, and trained by EM from the printed meter, without scansion labels. On a held-out set it scans 77.6% of the test lines fully correctly, against 26.8% for the available rule-based scanner, 55.0% for a neural tagger trained with the same supervision and 63.6% for Claude Opus 5.5 few-shot. The code is open-sourced and the tool is released on the web.

arxiv.title: CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation
arxiv.abstract: Stellarators are fusion devices that use externally generated, three-dimensional magnetic fields to confine hot plasma and offer a promising route to commercial fusion. Their electromagnetic coils pose a challenging design problem: they must reproduce the target magnetic field while satisfying engineering constraints and remaining practical and cost-effective to manufacture. Finding suitable geometries is a highly nonlinear inverse problem that generally has neither a closed-form nor a unique solution. This problem lies at the heart of stellarator design. We introduce CoilStellaration, a dataset and benchmark for learning the mapping between coil geometries from target plasma magnetic fields and engineering requirements. The dataset contains 177,000 optimized filamentary coilsets targeting plasma equilibria from ConStellaration, with sampled engineering requirements and achieved geometric and magnetic-field metrics. It spans multiple coil counts and field-period numbers, supporting studies of both specialized and shared models across configurations. The benchmark asks models to predict coils conditioned on a target equilibrium and requirements on coil-coil and coil-plasma spacing, curvature, and magnetic-field error. We show that magnetic-field accuracy remains the main challenge, with learned models rarely satisfying all requirements simultaneously. However, using learned predictions to initialize conventional coil optimization can accelerate early progress. We release baseline models and evaluation code to support reproducible research on both direct coil generation and learned optimization initializations. By lowering the barrier for machine learning and optimization researchers to engage with stellarator coil design, we aim to accelerate progress toward practical, cost-effective stellarator power plants.

arxiv.summaryZh: 针对仿星器线圈设计这一高度非线性的逆问题，构建了连接目标等离子体磁场与线圈几何的数据集与基准。数据集包含 177,000 组经优化的丝状线圈组，覆盖 ConStellaration 的等离子体平衡，并带有采样得到的工程约束（线圈间与线圈—等离子体间距、曲率）和实际达到的几何与磁场指标，跨多种线圈数与场周期数，支持专用模型与共享模型研究。基准要求模型在给定平衡与工程约束下预测线圈；结果显示磁场精度仍是主要瓶颈，学习模型很少能同时满足全部约束，但用其预测初始化传统线圈优化可加速前期收敛。发布了基线模型与评测代码，降低了 ML 与优化研究者进入仿星器线圈设计的门槛。

arxiv.title: Interpretability Is Not Model-Specific
arxiv.abstract: Interpretability tools are usually built for one model at a time: a refusal direction, a truthfulness probe, or a steering vector is found with labeled data inside the model it explains. We ask whether such tools can be carried to other models through a map between residual streams fit only on unlabeled prompts. We transfer a refusal direction, tested causally by addition and ablation, and two read-out tools, a correctness direction and a sentiment probe, across 110 pairs of models from five families and 1B to 72B parameters and between base and instruction-tuned models, with controls for specificity and five seeds. How much transfers depends on what the map was fit on. A map fit on ordinary questions recovers 54\% of the target's own refusal steering and 16\% to 77\% of its correctness gain; adding unlabeled prompts from the region where the tool operates raises these to 102\% and 88\% to 98\%, while control directions recover at most 1\%. We prove that a linear map behaves this way whenever two models correspond linearly on the data it covers, and a label-free coverage score derived from this result tracks recovery across more than 16,000 runs and explains earlier reports that maps between models fail across domains. Carried read-out tools outperform anything the target's unlabeled representations yield. Interpretability results, once found, can be reused across models at the cost of a few unlabeled prompts.

arxiv.title: Controlled Binary Assignment Flows
arxiv.abstract: This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

arxiv.title: Trade Promotion Optimisation for Consumer Goods
arxiv.abstract: Trade promotions consume a large share of consumer-goods revenue, yet most planners still set discounts with a single, often unreliable, price elasticity per item. We present an end-to-end Trade Promotion Optimisation (TPO) system built as one chain: analogue SKUs, point elasticity, elasticity curve, price recommendation, promotional lift and net lift. Elasticity is measured at post-promo time from directional price-dip events against a rolling regular price, and at promo time by a causal estimator that residualises trend, seasonality and promotion, handles stock-out censoring with a Tobit likelihood and updates itself from the first clean promotion week. Items with weak evidence borrow the point elasticity and the curvature from analogue SKUs chosen by a cross-validated ridge model over category, brand, sub-category, price line and description. The optimiser separates self-price lift from substitution and post-promo dips and adjusts for inventory and trade funding. In a four-week promotion experiment on a 39-SKU consumer brand (mean elasticity -3.06), the plan lifts units by 20.6% and revenue by 6.9% at flat margin. Analogue pooling halves elasticity error relative to hierarchy averaging.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向快消品的促销优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对快消品促销仍普遍依赖单品单一且不可靠价格弹性的问题，构建端到端促销优化链路:用同向价格下探事件对滚动常规价测量促销后弹性，并用因果估计器在促销期残差化趋势、季节性与促销，以 Tobit 似然处理缺货截断、从首个干净促销周起自更新;证据弱的单品从按品类、品牌、子品类、价格带与描述经交叉验证 ridge 选出的类比 SKU 借用点弹性与曲率。优化器将自价格提升与替代、促销后回落分离，并校正库存与促销资金。在含 39 个 SKU、平均弹性 -3.06 的品牌四周促销实验中，方案在毛利持平下提升销量 20.6%、收入 6.9%，类比池化相对层级平均将弹性误差减半。

arxiv.title: Certify, Report, or Refuse: Harm-Constrained Conformal Prediction for Clinical Actions
arxiv.abstract: Routing a melanoma case to routine follow-up is a serious action error that diagnostic coverage alone does not rule out. We present Harm-Constrained Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction (HC-ROCP), a training-free framework that uses frozen classifier probabilities and adds a harm penalty when choosing prediction sets and actions. We test the resulting policies on disjoint calibration splits with multiplicity adjustment. HC-ROCP certifies supported claims, reports descriptive fallback policies, and refuses unsupported subgroup claims. We evaluate these outputs retrospectively on COVID-19 radiographs, ISIC 2019 dermoscopy, and EyePACS-to-APTOS retinopathy transfer. Across ten calibration seeds, HC-ROCP reduces COVID-19 severe-action errors from the exact risk-optimal baseline's 4.68\% to 0.54\%. At a 5\% budget, global claims are certified for COVID-19 and ISIC, but the rare squamous-cell-carcinoma claim is refused. At 1\%, all settings receive descriptive reports. For each budget, we also report the minimum severe-case count needed to pass the global harm gate with zero errors, providing a starting point for further data collection.

arxiv.titleZh: 认证、报告或拒绝:面向临床行动的危害约束共形预测

arxiv.title: Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms often rely on data collected from a target environment, which can be expensive and noisy. Although simulators can generate large amounts of additional data, standard simulation mixing approaches, which directly combine simulated and real experience, can degrade performance due to simulator inaccuracies, especially when they bias the solution away from the optimal policy. We propose a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used solely to reduce variance in the learning process rather than directly shaping the learning target. We develop our approach for Policy-Evaluation, which is a fundamental building block of RL algorithms. Then we combine it within the actor-critic framework towards policy improvement, as well as extend it towards offline RL scenarios. Experiments on multiple MuJoCo benchmark tasks demonstrate improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches, highlighting control variates as an effective tool for simulation-aided reinforcement learning.

arxiv.titleZh: 基于控制变量的仿真辅助强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 仿真器可大量生成数据，但直接与真实经验混合会因仿真偏差把解拉离最优策略。该方法把仿真数据仅用于降低学习过程的方差，而不改变学习目标:以控制变量构造保守的策略评估器，再嵌入 actor-critic 框架做策略改进，并扩展到离线 RL。MuJoCo 多任务实验显示其优于标准仿真混合做法，说明控制变量是仿真辅助 RL 的有效工具。

arxiv.title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
arxiv.abstract: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.

arxiv.titleZh: TrialDesignBench：以临床知识为参照的语言模型 Phase-I 试验设计基准评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床试验的统计设计选型长期缺乏 AI 介入，而 FDA Project Optimus 等监管与方法学变化重定义了「合理设计」，使大量旧方案过时，也令既有评测失效。为此构建 TrialDesignBench，涵盖 617 项 I/I-II 期肿瘤剂量探索试验，每项配有经专家验证、符合最新监管要求的参考设计，参考标准由专家设计过程的形式化流程产出。评测 5 个前沿 LLM，无一达到参考标准；消融实验将差距归因于两点：从试验材料中推断未记录的隐含设计决定因素（直接提供后类别平衡准确率提升 0.22）与结构化决策树推理（提升 0.24）。该基准为 AI 辅助试验设计提供了可复现的当代标准评测目标。

arxiv.title: Beyond Sunny Skies: Using Large Language Models to Predict Urban Traffic in Adverse Weather
arxiv.abstract: Urban traffic flow prediction is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems, yet accurate forecasting under adverse weather conditions remains a significant challenge. Existing data-driven models, while effective for routine patterns, often struggle with the sparse data and complex non-linear shifts associated with rare meteorological events. These methods typically treat environmental contexts as shallow numerical features, failing to capture the underlying semantic reasoning-why and how specific adverse conditions alter mobility behaviors across regions with different functional compositions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.
arxiv.titleZh: 不止于晴空：用大语言模型预测恶劣天气下的城市交通
arxiv.summaryZh: 恶劣天气下的交通流预测面临样本稀疏与非线性突变，现有数据驱动模型只把天气等环境信息当作浅层数值特征，难以刻画其对不同功能区出行行为的影响。Multi-STG用LLM将天气、POI、节假日等上下文描述编码为语义嵌入，作为知识驱动的补充，再以多模态注意力融合异质输入，并用带门控残差校准的语义增强预测头调整输出。在三个城市真实私家车数据上，MAE较最强基线平均降低11.82%，且在稀疏与非平稳条件下保持稳定。适用于智能交通与城市出行预测场景。

arxiv.title: How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $α^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.

arxiv.summaryZh: Fisher二阶展开½ΔᵀFΔ常被用来低成本预测量化后KL散度，但其在真实GPU批次中的可靠性不明。对Qwen3与OLMo-2等五个模型的预注册测量显示，相对预测在16倍扰动尺度与不同int4 group size下成立，绝对预测呈重尾，12个单元格中10个截尾平均误差在15%内；MoE小扰动下呈非二次响应，int8 KL随α^0.63缩放，bf16逐序列梯度可致4倍误差，改用fp32消除。所建筛选器在未见Mistral-7B-v0.3上六个预测均落入区间、三个KL预算均满足，vLLM吞吐预测误差0.4%。

arxiv.title: Adapting Small Language Models to Romanized Nepali: Tokenizer Fertility, Reference Likelihood, and Generation Metrics
arxiv.abstract: Romanized Nepali, Nepali written in Latin script, is common in digital communication but has no standard spelling and few resources, and it is unclear how reliably small open language models can be adapted to it. We adapt three 2-3B base models from different families, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Gemma-2-2B, with QLoRA on 9,000 instruction examples produced by deterministic transliteration of Nepali instruction data. Each model is trained with one shared recipe and three seeds and evaluated on 1,000 held-out examples with reference-overlap metrics, byte-normalized reference likelihood (bits per byte, BPB), and an output audit, against zero-shot baselines under two prompts. Fine-tuning raises chrF++ from 10-14 to 29.0-30.6 and lowers BPB from 2.23-2.41 to 0.78-0.84; most zero-shot outputs (54-92%) are English-like. Likelihood and overlap disagree on how far apart the models are. Llama-3.2-3B has the lowest BPB in every seed, 0.042 below Qwen2.5-3B (95% CI 0.039-0.046), yet the two cannot be separated on chrF++ (30.51 and 30.61) or BLEU, even with paired item-level tests. Gemma-2-2B, whose tokenizer splits Romanized Nepali words least (2.72 tokens per word), scores worst on every measure. Which model gains most over its zero-shot baseline depends on the zero-shot prompt. In a supplementary comparison with an identical tokenizer, Llama-3.1-8B lowers BPB by 0.053 (0.050-0.056) relative to Llama-3.2-3B, while chrF++ and BLEU rise by only 0.68 and 0.58 points. Lower fertility and higher reference likelihood therefore did not identify the model whose outputs were closest to the references.
arxiv.titleZh: 将小语言模型适配到罗马化尼泊尔语：分词器生育率、参考似然与生成指标
arxiv.summaryZh: 罗马化尼泊尔语的拼写并不统一，资源也很稀缺，因此小模型能否可靠地适配到这种语言尚不清楚。研究用 QLoRA 在 9000 条由确定性转写生成的指令数据上微调 Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-3B 和 Gemma-2-2B，统一训练配方并使用三个随机种子，然后在 1000 条留出样本上，用参考重叠指标、按字节归一化的参考似然（BPB）和输出审计，与零样本基线对照。微调使 chrF++ 由 10–14 升至 29.0–30.6，使 BPB 由 2.23–2.41 降至 0.78–0.84。BPB 与重叠指标给出的模型排序并不一致：分词生育率最低的 Gemma-2-2B 在各项指标上表现最差，这说明低生育率与更高的参考似然未必能指认出输出最接近参考的模型。
arxiv.reason: 面向低资源语言适配与指标可靠性，但主题偏离核心方向

arxiv.title: Unmasking Four Knapsack Problems in the Traveling Thief Benchmark
arxiv.abstract: The traveling thief problem (TTP) asks a thief to choose a tour and a packing together, and the benchmark of 9,720 instances of Polyakovskiy et al. (2014) is the standard test set for comparing TTP heuristics. We show that four of these instances are not TTP instances at all. Their files give a renting rate of 0.00, so the tour has no effect on the objective and each instance reduces to a 0-1 knapsack problem. One of them belongs to the 60 categorized instances on which new methods are usually compared, and on it five of nine published methods report exactly the same value. The cause is the format of the files, which keep the renting rate with two decimals, while the rule of the generator gives a rate close to 0.003 on these instances. The same rounding may shift the rate of 949 other instances by more than 1%. Since the tour and the packing used by the generator were not published, the original rates cannot be recovered. We therefore define new rates with the same rule, applied to a fully specified reference solution that we publish, and we show with a published heuristic that the corrected instances behave as TTP instances again. We also give reference results on the corrected instances and recommendations for future studies. Finally, we present ttplib, a new open-source Python library that loads any of the 9,720 instances, including the corrected ones, without downloading the whole benchmark.
arxiv.titleZh: 揭示旅行窃贼基准中的四个背包问题
arxiv.summaryZh: 旅行窃贼问题（TTP）标准基准的9,720个实例中有4个因租金率被舍入为0.00而退化为0-1背包问题，其中一个属于常用的60个分类实例，使9种已发表方法中有5种报告相同值。根因是文件仅保留两位小数，而生成器规则给出的租金率约为0.003，同一舍入还可能让949个实例的租金率偏移超过1%。由于原始生成路径与装载方案未公开，租金率无法恢复；该工作按同一规则对公开参考解重新定义租金率，验证修正实例恢复TTP性质，并发布可免下载加载全部实例的ttplib库。
arxiv.reason: 组合优化基准纠错，与LLM/Agent方向无关

arxiv.title: Fairness in Explainable AI Narratives: Decomposing Social Disparities in LLM-Generated Explanations
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate technical explainable AI (XAI) artefacts such as SHAP into explanatory narratives (XAINs) for lay users. In high-risk domains, these explanations are often the main resource through which individuals can understand and contest adverse decisions. Yet LLMs are known to reproduce social bias, even from proxy variables alone, and fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Because XAINs are bound to a ground-truth artefact, fairness concerns not only what a narrative says and how, but also whether it is equally faithful across social groups. We introduce fairness in XAINs as a new field of research and propose a framework that generates narratives under three conditions (protected attribute disclosed, withheld, or counterfactually swapped), allowing five comparisons that pinpoint the cause of disparities. We apply it to adversely classified instances from four datasets in credit scoring, education and employment, generating narratives with five LLMs, and evaluate faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. We find significant disparities across all datasets, metric families and models, arising in two ways. Faithfulness disparities result from feature values: LLMs make plausible but false statements, triggered by values that are unequally distributed across social groups. Feature coverage and sentiment disparities stem from the protected attribute itself: once it is disclosed, LLMs give less explanation to, or frame more negatively the narratives of, groups that have historically been discriminated against or are stereotypically associated with worse outcomes. A more faithful model removes the faithfulness disparities, and withholding protected attributes mostly removes the others, but neither suffices on its own. Fairness in XAINs should therefore be audited separately from the predictive model and its XAI artefact.
arxiv.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Code, prompts, narratives and extractions available at https://github.com/WannesVandenBulck/fairxain
arxiv.titleZh: 可解释 AI 叙事中的公平性：分解 LLM 生成解释中的社会差异
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 常将 SHAP 等技术可解释性产物转写为面向普通用户的解释叙事（XAIN），其公平性尚未被研究。该工作提出三条件生成框架（受保护属性公开、隐藏、反事实交换），通过五组对比定位差异来源，在信贷、教育、就业四个数据集的负面判定样本上用五个 LLM 生成叙事并评估忠实性、特征覆盖度与情感倾向。结果各数据集、指标族与模型均存在显著差异：忠实性差异由特征取值触发，覆盖度与情感差异源于受保护属性本身；更忠实的模型可消除前者，隐藏属性可基本消除后者，但单独均不充分。XAIN 公平性应与预测模型及其 XAI 产物分开审计。
arxiv.reason: LLM 公平性审计，属评测侧，与后训练/Agent 主线擦边

arxiv.title: TRACE: Adaptive Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization for Open-Ended Molecular Design
arxiv.abstract: Optimizing molecules under small evaluation budgets requires deciding both where in chemical space to search and which candidate within that region to evaluate. We introduce Trust Region Adaptive Chemical Exploration (TRACE), a framework for open-ended molecular Bayesian optimization (BO), where candidates are generated on demand rather than selected from a fixed library. TRACE combines an objective-free graph-perturbation mechanism with a fixed, chemistry-aware Gaussian process (GP) surrogate using fragprints, a representation combining molecular fingerprints and fragment descriptors. Rather than learning the search geometry itself, TRACE makes the scale of chemical exploration explicit through a Tanimoto-similarity threshold controlling chemical extent and a cardinality budget controlling candidate-search breadth. A simple success/failure controller expands or contracts both quantities during optimization, while the GP and acquisition function select which admissible molecules to evaluate. Across six challenging molecular optimization benchmarks under matched 1,000-evaluation budgets, TRACE achieves the strongest overall sample efficiency as measured by the best molecule found as evaluations accumulate. Crossed ablations on two objectives further show that adaptive region control contributes beyond the proposal mechanism, while its benefit depends on the proposal distribution. We further apply TRACE to the stability of iron phthalocyanine (FePc), a non-precious molecular electrocatalyst whose degradation can involve loss of the Fe center. Using a first-principles density functional theory (DFT) workflow designed for accurate energy evaluation, TRACE increases the computed thermodynamic resistance to Fe dissolution from 0.42 to 2.59 eV over 80 designed evaluations.
arxiv.titleZh: TRACE：面向开放式分子设计的自适应信赖域贝叶斯优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 在极小评估预算下做分子优化，需要同时决定搜索哪片化学空间以及在该区域内评估哪个候选，开放式设定下候选按需生成而非取自固定库。TRACE 用无目标函数的图扰动机制按需生成分子，配合基于 fragprints（分子指纹与片段描述符的组合表示）的固定化学感知高斯过程代理模型，并以 Tanimoto 相似度阈值控制化学空间范围、以基数预算控制候选搜索广度，再由简单的成功/失败控制器在优化过程中自适应扩张或收缩这两个量。在六个分子优化基准、统一 1000 次评估预算下取得最佳整体样本效率；在 FePc 电催化剂稳定性任务上，经 80 次设计评估将其抗 Fe 溶解的热力学指标从 0.42 eV 提升到 2.59 eV。
arxiv.reason: 分子贝叶斯优化与化学设计，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.
arxiv.titleZh: AgentOPSD：通过递归信念修正实现轮级信用分配
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长程多轮 Agent 任务中 RLVR 只把单一优势铺在整条轨迹上、粒度过粗而难以定位关键决策的问题，提出无 critic 的逐轮信用分配方案：在每个交互轮内将技能条件自教师与学生的 token 级对数概率差求和，作为证据在对数几率空间做递归贝叶斯更新，得到有界且保号的乘子，把结果优势重新分配到各轮。在 ALFWorld 上以 Qwen2.5-3B 与 7B 为策略骨干，稳定优于 GRPO 与自蒸馏基线，7B 规模达 89.1% 成功率；消融表明增益来自轮边界处的证据聚合与依赖历史的信念修正，而非局部差值本身。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 轮级信用分配新机制，命中 Agent 与后训练方向
